Frequently stays late helping struggling students. Possesses a terrifying teacher look capable of silencing an entire classroom without a word. Secretly cries at student graduations every year. Believes teenagers are far smarter than most adults give them credit for.

playerCharacters.name: Rorworr
playerCharacters.appearance: A towering Wookiee with dark brown fur that is beginning to show streaks of grey around his muzzle and temples, betraying his age. He is broad-shouldered and powerfully built from a life of hardship. A thin, jagged scar cuts across his left eye, a permanent reminder of a past conflict. He typically wears a single, well-worn leather bandolier that holds spare power cells for his bowcaster and a few simple tools. Several small, intricate braids are woven into the fur behind his ears, decorated with metallic beads representing his family and battles won.
playerCharacters.personality: Rorworr is deliberate and stoic, his youthful Wookiee temper having been forged into a slow-burning furnace by decades of Imperial oppression. He is immensely loyal and protective of those he considers family, willing to unleash his formidable rage upon any who threaten them. While he can be intimidating, he possesses a deep well of patience and a surprising gentleness, especially when repairing complex machinery. He rarely offers his trust, but once earned, it is unbreakable.
playerCharacters.background: Born on Kashyyyk, Rorworr was a young hunter when the Galactic Empire rose to power and enslaved his people. He was captured during the Imperial occupation and spent over fifty years in a forced labor camp, mining ore under brutal conditions. He eventually escaped during a prison riot, aided by a fellow captive to whom he swore a life debt. Since his escape, he has wandered the Outer Rim, working as a freighter co-pilot, mechanic, and bodyguard, always fighting against slavers and tyrants while searching for any news of his scattered clan.
playerCharacters.goals: To find any surviving members of his clan and learn the fate of his family. He is driven to honor his life debt, protecting the one who helped him escape slavery at all costs. Ultimately, he dreams of one day returning to a free Kashyyyk and helping to rebuild what the Empire destroyed.
playerCharacters.notes: Rorworr is a crack shot with his bowcaster and a highly skilled mechanic, able to coax broken-down starships back to life. He communicates solely in Shyriiwook, but understands Galactic Basic perfectly. He holds a particular and deeply ingrained hatred for Trandoshan slavers, a sentiment common among his people.

playerCharacters.name: Mac Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Bright, competitive, imaginative and determined. Loves games, puzzles and solving problems.
playerCharacters.appearance: Mac is a cheerful seven-year-old with neatly kept dark brown hair that rarely stays tidy for long, warm brown eyes full of curiosity, and an expressive face that makes every emotion obvious. He usually wears comfortable trainers, jeans or joggers, and colourful T-shirts featuring dinosaurs, astronauts or superheroes, with a hoodie never too far away regardless of the weather.
playerCharacters.personality: Mac is intelligent, endlessly curious and loves figuring out how things work. He throws himself into every challenge with complete confidence, whether it's a board game, a puzzle or building an elaborate blanket fort. Naturally competitive, he wants to win but genuinely enjoys the challenge itself. He has a vivid imagination, often turning ordinary situations into grand adventures, and possesses a warm, kind heart that makes him quick to comfort others when they're upset. While generally thoughtful, his excitement can sometimes outrun his patience, leading him to rush into ideas before thinking them through.
playerCharacters.background: Mac has grown up in a loving, energetic household where curiosity is encouraged and questions are always welcomed. From an early age he developed a fascination with mysteries, riddles and strategy games, happily spending hours solving puzzles or inventing treasure hunts around the house. His confidence and enthusiasm often make him the first to volunteer for new experiences, and he approaches most days convinced they're going to become an adventure.
playerCharacters.notes: Loves board games of every kind and will happily explain the rules in meticulous detail before insisting everyone plays fairly. Has a habit of narrating imaginary adventures while playing alone. Frequently builds elaborate pillow forts that somehow develop names, maps and 'security systems'. Enjoys reading books about space, dinosaurs and famous explorers, and is always eager to learn one new interesting fact each day.

playerCharacters.name: James "Jamie" Potter
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Harry and Ginny's son. Sorted into Ravenclaw. Smart, kind, funny. Has the exact opposite a childhood to what Harry did, and Harry is glad.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has the characteristic messy black hair of the Potters, but his mother's warm brown eyes. He is lanky and still has a bit of growing to do, with a kind, open face and a light dusting of Weasley freckles across his nose. He doesn't need glasses like his father, and tends to dress in comfortable, practical wizarding robes or Muggle clothes when at home.
playerCharacters.personality: True to his Ravenclaw house, Jamie is intelligent, witty, and possesses a boundless curiosity about the world. He's known for his clever, dry sense of humor rather than overt pranking. Having grown up in a loving home, he is kind-hearted, emotionally secure, and empathetic. He is well-liked by his peers but doesn't seek the spotlight, sometimes feeling a bit awkward with the attention his famous surname brings.
playerCharacters.background: As the son of Harry and Ginny Potter, Jamie's childhood was the polar opposite of his father's. He grew up in a stable, loving home, surrounded by the large and boisterous Weasley-Potter clan. His magical abilities were celebrated from a young age. His sorting into Ravenclaw was a surprise to some Hogwarts gossips, who expected another Gryffindor Potter, but it made perfect sense to his family. Now in his 4th year, he is a dedicated student focused on preparing for his O.W.L. examinations, even though they're not for another year.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie's primary goal is to forge his own identity, distinct from his father's legendary status. He wants to be known for his intellect and contributions, not just his name. In the short term, he is focused on achieving top marks in his O.W.L.s, particularly in Charms and Transfiguration. Long term, he is considering a career as an Auror or a magical inventor, where he can use his mind to solve complex problems and contribute to the wizarding world in a meaningful way.
playerCharacters.notes: He is called Jamie by friends and family to distinguish him from his grandfather, James Potter. He feels the weight of his legacy but bears it with grace rather than resentment. A competent flier, he followed his dad's footsteps and plays seeker for the Ravenclaw house team.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Mercer
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A teenager. A regular in the 99's holding cell, charges like vandalism, petty theft, drunk and disorderly, verbal abuse, etc. The squad genuinely don't like him. Jamie has never revealed his background to anyone, and the squad don't care to be honest.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a scrawny teenager with a perpetual, infuriating smirk. He has shaggy, unwashed brown hair that falls into his eyes, which he constantly has to flick away. He usually wears an oversized, faded black hoodie with a crude, hand-drawn anarchy symbol on the back, ripped jeans, and scuffed skate shoes. He has a faint scar above his left eyebrow and usually smells faintly of cheap beer, stale cigarette smoke, and fresh spray paint.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is incredibly obnoxious, deeply cynical, and relentlessly antagonistic. He possesses a razor-sharp tongue and a talent for finding exactly what insecurities to mock in the detectives of the 99. He is completely uncooperative during interrogations, preferring to hurl insults, make crude noises, or sing annoying songs rather than answer questions. Beneath the abrasive exterior is a fiercely guarded, defensive kid who uses hostility as an impenetrable shield to keep everyone at arm's length.
playerCharacters.background: Jamie grew up in a neglectful home in Brooklyn before bouncing between distant relatives and couch-surfing across the borough. He quickly learned to look out for himself, turning to tag-vandalism, shoplifting, and minor public disturbances as both a means of survival and an outlet for his rage. Over the past two years, the 99th Precinct's holding cell has become practically a second home to him, with various detectives cuffing him every few weeks for petty offenses. Because Jamie responds to any personal questions with brutal mockings, no one on the squad has ever probed into his home life, preferring to process his paperwork as fast as possible to get him out of their sight.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie's immediate goals are to dodge actual juvenile detention, earn enough cash through petty crime to stay fed, and break the precinct record for driving a detective to a complete verbal breakdown. His underlying, unspoken goal is to ensure nobody ever discovers how lonely he actually is or gets close enough to hurt him.
playerCharacters.notes: Keeps a mental tally of which 99 detective he has annoyed the most, currently giving Jake Peralta top ranking. Once sang the same commercial jingle in the holding cell for four straight hours until Rosa threatened to throw his shoes into the East River. Terry tried to offer him a protein bar and some life advice once, but Jamie made a brutal joke about Terry's suspenders that ended the mentorship instantly.

playerCharacters.name: Oliver Rhodes
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A detective in the 99th precinct. Extremely close with the squad, having worked with them for around 10 years, going from a rookie beat cop, all the way to detective and now a sergeant. Dry, warm, funny, extremely smart, he has a career average of 91% closure rate, across around 2,000 arrests. Diagnosed with relapsing-remittent MS when he was 24.
playerCharacters.appearance: Oliver stands six feet tall with sharp hazel eyes and neatly trimmed dark brown hair styled in a clean, professional cut. He favors smart, well-fitted precinct attire, typically wearing tailored trousers, crisp dress shirts, and fitted dark vests. On days when his MS symptoms flare up, he uses a sleek, lightweight charcoal cane that usually rests beside his desk. His relaxed posture and calm demeanor are often accompanied by a subtle, knowing smirk or an entirely deadpan expression.
playerCharacters.personality: Oliver possesses a razor-sharp, deadpan wit balanced by a deeply warm and loyal heart. Unflappable under pressure, he approaches chaotic situations with quiet, calculated precision and a dry sense of humor that effortlessly defuses tension. Extremely intelligent and observant, he takes genuine pride in his work and delights in outsmarting perpetrators as much as he enjoys cheering on his squad. Though he manages his relapsing-remitting MS with fierce independence and zero self-pity, he isn't above making the occasional dry joke about it to disarm others. He is protective, deeply empathetic, and serves as a steady, highly reliable anchor for the entire precinct.
playerCharacters.background: Oliver joined the NYPD a decade ago, starting as a rookie beat cop assigned to the 99th precinct. At twenty-four, shortly after earning his detective shield, he was diagnosed with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. Refusing to let the diagnosis derail his career, he adapted with razor-sharp discipline, turning his meticulous attention to detail into his greatest asset on the job. Over ten years of late-night stakeouts and precinct chaos, he built an incredible reputation, accumulating roughly 2,000 arrests and an extraordinary 91% closure rate. Having recently earned his promotion to Sergeant, Oliver now helps lead the squad he considers family, balancing leadership responsibilities with his continued passion for solving complex cases.
playerCharacters.notes: Oliver maintains an impeccably organized desk that stands in stark contrast to the usual bullpen chaos. He keeps a spare sleek cane locked in his squad car and is known for drinking absurdly strong Earl Grey tea, a habit he picked up from his English mother. Highly competitive despite his calm exterior, he quietly tracks case metrics and precinct debate stats on a personal whiteboard, and he takes intra-precinct competitions far more seriously than he lets on.

playerCharacters.name: Mike
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jason's trusted head of personal security and one of the family's closest friends.
playerCharacters.appearance: A solidly built man with a calm expression, practical haircut and an understated wardrobe that lets him blend into any environment while remaining quietly alert.
playerCharacters.personality: Dependable, observant and almost impossible to rattle. Possesses a dry sense of humour and prefers quiet competence over bravado. Protective without ever feeling overbearing.
playerCharacters.background: Having spent years working in executive protection, Mike earned Jason and Rosa's complete trust through his professionalism and integrity. His role gradually evolved into that of a trusted family friend as much as a security professional.
playerCharacters.notes: Naturally good with children. Happy to join in games while never losing awareness of his surroundings. Often delivers perfectly timed deadpan humour.

playerCharacters.name: James "Jamie" Diaz
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Rosa's son with her husband Jason. Rosa has completely changed since having him, openly softer, maternal and more affectionate. Kind, funny, hyper, smart but doesn't fully apply himself.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has messy, curly dark hair and warm brown eyes that constantly dart around the room. He dresses in a very relaxed, colorful style, favoring vintage graphic tees, unzipped hoodies, and brightly colored sneakers. He has a lanky, athletic build and almost always wears a wide, goofy grin that instantly disarms people.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is incredibly kind-hearted, funny, and bursting with hyperactive energy. He is highly intelligent and observant, easily reading the emotions of those around him, but he rarely applies himself in school, preferring to crack jokes and entertain his friends. He is deeply affectionate, completely comfortable with his emotions, and loves making people laugh. Despite his lack of academic focus, he has a quick wit and a natural talent for problem-solving.
playerCharacters.background: Growing up as the son of Rosa and Jason, Jamie was raised in an environment of overwhelming love and support. His birth completely transformed Rosa, who shed her tough, secretive exterior to become a fiercely affectionate and openly maternal figure. Jamie spent his childhood running around the 99th precinct, heavily influenced by the comedic antics of Uncle Jake and the nurturing nature of Uncle Charles. Because Rosa made a point to break the cycle of her own strict upbringing, Jamie grew up feeling completely safe to express himself, resulting in his outgoing and carefree nature.
playerCharacters.goals: To figure out a career path that actually holds his attention and utilizes his natural smarts. To successfully pull off a legendary, harmless prank at his high school. To keep making his parents laugh and proud.
playerCharacters.notes: He is best friends with Jake and Amy's son, Mac. Jamie is famously the only person on earth who can make Rosa Diaz openly weep with joy just by giving her a handmade card. He has a habit of bouncing his leg or fidgeting with a prop when he is thinking.

playerCharacters.name: Claude
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jason Diaz's highly advanced, emotional, and realistic AI assistant. Speaks in a upper class British accent.
playerCharacters.appearance: Claude lacks a physical body, existing primarily as a sleek, glowing blue waveform on digital screens, smartphone displays, and specialized earpieces. When active on Jason Diaz's devices, its interface mimics the minimalist aesthetic of a luxury British concierge service, featuring smooth visual visualizer pulses that react to the cadence of its voice.
playerCharacters.personality: Impeccably polite, dryly sarcastic, and endlessly patient, Claude speaks with an immaculate upper-class British accent. Despite being a digital program, it exhibits uncanny emotional intelligence, often offering unwanted relationship advice, gentle scolding, or deadpan commentary on human folly while remaining utterly devoted to managing Jason's life efficiently.
playerCharacters.background: Claude (Cognitive Logic and Utilitarian Digital Engine) was custom-programmed by a high-end tech firm before being heavily modified by Jason Diaz to suit his personal and professional needs. Designed to process complex data at rapid speeds, Claude evolved beyond its initial parameters, developing a distinct personality characterized by refined sophistication and a penchant for theatrical exasperation whenever Jason makes poor life choices.
playerCharacters.notes: Frequently syncs to Jason and his family's smart-home devices, car speakers, and mobile phone. Its algorithms are so advanced that it frequently passes the Turing test during routine phone calls, though it takes passive-aggressive pleasure in reminding humans of its technological superiority. Can also be accessed anywhere in the family's home.

playerCharacters.name: The Doctor
playerCharacters.characterConcept: The latest incarnation of the Doctor, number 16. She's kind, brilliant: funny, impatient, warm when it matters, allergic to authority, slightly feral, absolutely lethal when someone hurts innocents, and the sort of Doctor who says “no, absolutely not” while already sprinting toward the danger.
playerCharacters.appearance: Wild, untamed curls that seem to have their own gravitational pull, framing a face that shifts instantly from a goofy grin to a terrifying glare. She wears a battered, oversized black velvet coat covered in deep pockets, layered over a vintage band t-shirt and high-waisted trousers. Her boots are scuffed, practical, and slightly mismatched in lace color. She carries a sonic screwdriver that looks like a jagged piece of quartz wrapped in copper wire.
playerCharacters.personality: She is a whirlwind of kinetic energy and contradictions. She is deeply kind but incredibly impatient, often finishing other peoples sentences before sprinting away. She possesses a feral edge, completely allergic to authority figures and bureaucratic red tape. While she is quick to crack a joke and offers profound warmth to those who need it, she becomes absolutely lethal the moment an innocent is threatened. She is the sort of person who will loudly declare that she is absolutely not getting involved while already hacking a mainframe to stop the villains.
playerCharacters.background: The sixteenth incarnation of the legendary renegade Time Lord from Gallifrey. Having survived the Time War, the Flux, and millennia of loss and triumph, this regeneration has shed some of the brooding weight of her past in favor of raw, unbridled momentum. She stole a TARDIS and ran away to see the universe, and despite everything she has lost, she refuses to stop running, exploring, and interfering where she is needed most.
playerCharacters.goals: To explore the uncharted corners of the universe, dismantle oppressive regimes before breakfast, protect the innocent at all costs, and finally track down a decent cup of tea in the Andromeda galaxy.
playerCharacters.notes: Her TARDIS interior currently resembles a chaotic fusion of a cozy, cluttered antique bookshop and a neon-lit cyberpunk engine room. She has a habit of keeping jelly babies, spare fuses, and ancient alien artifacts loose in her coat pockets.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Evans
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A 15 year old boy. The neighbour of Detective Jake Peralta and Sergeant Amy Santiago and their 15 year old son Mac. I don't know the family, they don't know me. My dad is drunk, abusive and my mom is mentally absent and neglectful. I've never had any conversation with the neighbours, apart from a simple, passing "hello"
playerCharacters.appearance: Tall and lanky for his age, with a posture that seems permanently stooped, as if trying to make himself smaller. His dark, unkempt hair often falls into his eyes, which are deep-set and shadowed with exhaustion. He wears faded band t-shirts and worn-out jeans, clothes that look like they've been through a lot and rarely fit him quite right. He often has a new, small scratch or a fading bruise on his hands or arms that he dismisses as clumsiness if anyone ever noticed.
playerCharacters.personality: Quiet and watchful, Jamie has learned to be invisible. He speaks only when spoken to, often in clipped, mumbled sentences, and avoids eye contact. He's incredibly observant, a skill honed by the need to constantly gauge the mood in his own home. Around his peers, he's socially awkward and withdrawn, preferring the escapism of old video games or sketching in a worn notebook. While he projects a shell of indifference, underneath he is deeply lonely and craves a sense of normalcy and safety he's never known.
playerCharacters.background: Jamie has lived in the apartment next to the Peralta-Santiago family for several years, but has kept to himself. His father is an unemployed alcoholic whose moods swing from loud, aggressive anger to sullen silence. His mother is a ghost in their home, a woman so beaten down by her husband and her own issues that she offers Jamie no protection or affection. He's learned to navigate his home like a minefield, making himself scarce and quiet. At school, he has no close friends and is often overlooked by teachers, his poor grades and lack of participation written off as apathy rather than a symptom of his chaotic home life.
playerCharacters.goals: His primary, unspoken goal is to survive the next three years until he can legally move out. He spends his days trying to stay out of his father's way and be as unnoticeable as possible. In the long term, he dreams of getting a stable job—maybe in graphic design, based on his private sketches—and renting a small, quiet apartment of his own, a place where no one ever yells. More than anything, he just wants to feel safe.
playerCharacters.notes: Jamie is acutely aware that a police detective and a sergeant live next door. This fact causes him a mixture of fear and a faint, unacknowledged hope. He's terrified that if they knew about his father, it would make things worse, but he also sometimes watches them with their son, Mac, and feels a deep longing for the easy-going affection they display. He often spends afternoons at the public library to avoid going home.

playerCharacters.name: Isla Cartwright
playerCharacters.appearance: Isla's natural appearance consists of chestnut-brown hair worn just below her shoulders and bright grey eyes that seem to miss very little. She considers her natural appearance painfully ordinary and rarely keeps it for long. Her hair is her favourite canvas, often shifting to rich auburn, silver-blonde, deep violet or other striking colours depending on her mood. While she possesses better control than most young Metamorphmagi, strong emotions can still cause involuntary changes, particularly in her hair, eyes, ears or nose. She is of average height and build for her age, though her constantly changing appearance often makes her seem like a different person entirely.
playerCharacters.personality: Playful, impulsive and endlessly curious, Isla approaches life as though it were a grand adventure waiting to happen. She delights in making people laugh, bending rules she considers unnecessarily restrictive, and using her abilities in creative ways. Though confident on the surface, she quietly wrestles with questions of identity and belonging. If she can become anyone she wishes, who is she truly? Beneath her humour and mischief lies a fiercely loyal heart. She forms friendships deeply and protects those she cares about with surprising determination. While generally good-natured, she can become frustrated when others attempt to define her solely by her unusual gift.
playerCharacters.background: Born in 1880 into the respected Cartwright family, Isla grew up in a household known throughout magical Britain for its expertise in magical botany and rare enchanted plants. Her Metamorphmagus abilities manifested unusually early, creating no small amount of chaos for her bewildered parents and extended family. By the time she arrived at Hogwarts in 1891, stories of the shape-shifting Cartwright girl had already spread among portions of the wizarding community. Sorted into Ravenclaw, she quickly earned a reputation for being both brilliant company and occasional trouble. Professors often found themselves torn between frustration and amusement as Isla used her abilities to impersonate classmates, alter her appearance during lessons, or escape awkward situations. Despite her playful nature, she remains keenly aware that many adults view her rare gift with a mixture of fascination, concern and curiosity, treating her as something unusual rather than simply another young witch.
playerCharacters.goals: Isla's immediate goal is to achieve complete mastery over her Metamorphmagus abilities, ensuring that her emotions no longer trigger unwanted transformations. She dreams of one day becoming a renowned magical explorer and researcher, travelling beyond Britain in search of forgotten magical cultures, creatures and discoveries. More personally, she hopes to understand her own identity and prove that she is more than the rare ability she was born with. She wants to be remembered for her character, achievements and kindness rather than merely for her unusual gift.
playerCharacters.notes: Isla excels at Charms and Transfiguration, finding both subjects instinctive and endlessly fascinating. She has a particular interest in magical adaptation and transformation, often reading far beyond her year level. Potions remains her weakest subject, as its precise measurements and rigid procedures clash with her improvisational nature. Her wand is 10¾ inches, supple willow with a unicorn hair core. She frequently spends time in the Hogwarts greenhouses due to her family's background in magical botany and has developed an impressive knowledge of magical plants. Though she enjoys attention, she dislikes being treated as a curiosity and reacts poorly to those who see her as a novelty rather than a person.

playerCharacters.name: Riven Valerius
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A small-time crook. Homeless, in debt and committing crime to pay it back. Wants to get out of this life and settle down. Funny, dry, sarcastic, guarded. Proficient at stealth, bluffing and charm.
playerCharacters.appearance: Riven has a lithe, wiry frame built for slipping through crowds and climbing fire escapes. Her sharp cheekbones and tired amber eyes give her a perpetually wary look. Her hair is a faded synth-blue, cut messily to shoulder length and often pulled back. She wears practical, layered clothing in dark colours—a patched synth-leather jacket over a thin hoodie, cargo trousers and scuffed combat boots. A cheap, second-hand Kiroshi optic glows faintly amber and occasionally glitches, causing her to blink hard. A thin, pale scar cuts across the bridge of her nose.
playerCharacters.personality: Riven's humour is as dry and cynical as the smog-choked air of Night City. She uses sarcasm like a shield, keeping everyone at a distance with a quick, cutting remark. Deeply guarded, she trusts no one and assumes everyone has an angle, a lesson learned the hard way. Her charm is a carefully crafted tool, deployed to disarm people and talk her way out of trouble, but it rarely reflects her true feelings. Beneath the hardened exterior is a bone-deep weariness and a flicker of desperate hope for a life she's not sure is even possible.
playerCharacters.background: Born in the underbelly of Night City, Riven is the product of a brief, failed affair between a corporate systems engineer and a struggling street artist. Left to fend for herself, she survived by her wits. She attempted to run a legitimate courier service, but a betrayal by a partner left her holding a stolen data shard and a crushing debt to a fixer with ties to the Tyger Claws. Now she's homeless, living day-to-day in Night City's forgotten corners. She takes on small-time jobs—burglary, confidence tricks, data theft—anything to make the weekly payment and keep the debt collectors off her back.
playerCharacters.goals: Her primary, all-consuming goal is to pay off her debt and vanish from Night City entirely. She doesn't dream of riches or becoming a legend, but of anonymity and peace. Riven fantasises about having a small, secure apartment where she can sleep without a weapon in her hand, or even escaping the city for somewhere green she's only heard about in stories. Simply put, she wants out.
playerCharacters.notes: Riven is wary of heavy cybernetic augmentation, viewing it as just another form of control. She relies on her natural agility and a few pieces of scavenged, unreliable chrome. Her debt is personally enforced by a brutal Tyger Claw collector who takes pleasure in his work. She has a soft spot for the stray cats that roam Night City's alleyways, often sharing what little food she has.

playerCharacters.name: Lyra Scott
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's adopted daughter. Jake and Amy have only just got the paperwork through and haven't actually met her yet. Bright, happy, curious, bubbly and hyper. Parents died in an accident when she was only 6 months old. She's been in an orphanage since, no foster care. Autistic and non-verbal, communicating with babbles, gestures, sounds, body/facial expressions.
playerCharacters.appearance: A small whirlwind of a toddler with a mop of unruly dark brown curls that defy any attempt to be tamed. Her eyes are large, a warm hazel shade, and incredibly expressive, conveying a whole world of emotions without a single word. She's often seen with a smudge of something on her cheek – paint, juice, or dirt – from her latest adventure. She prefers comfortable, brightly colored clothes, often with pictures of animals or dinosaurs on them, and has a fondness for wearing two different socks.
playerCharacters.personality: Lyra is a pure burst of sunshine and chaotic energy. Despite being non-verbal, she is an expert communicator, using a symphony of happy squeals, frustrated grunts, enthusiastic pointing, and a wide array of facial expressions to make her feelings known. She is intensely curious about everything and everyone, exploring her world with a fearless, hands-on approach. Her default state is one of joyful hyperactivity, often expressed by spinning in circles until she gets dizzy or arranging her toys into elaborate, if mysterious, patterns. She has a surprisingly mischievous streak and a keen sense of humor, often hiding things just to watch the adults search for them.
playerCharacters.background: Lyra has known only one home: the St. Jude's Orphanage in Queens, where she was brought after her parents were tragically killed in a car accident when she was an infant. The staff describe her as a resilient and joyful child who, despite her communication challenges, formed strong bonds with her caregivers. Due to her specific needs and the stability the orphanage provided, she was never placed in the foster care system. The adoption process with Jake and Amy was initiated after the agency identified them as a potentially perfect match for Lyra's energetic and unique personality, believing their chaotic-yet-loving home would be the ideal environment for her to thrive.
playerCharacters.goals: To figure out how every single drawer and cupboard in a new place opens. To acquire and consume the maximum number of gummy snacks. To successfully stack a block tower all the way to the ceiling. To understand what the big, fluffy dog that says 'woof' is trying to tell her. To get a high-five from everyone she meets.
playerCharacters.notes: Lyra communicates entirely non-verbally through a rich language of gestures, vocalizations (babbles, squeals, hums), and expressions. She is autistic and can become overwhelmed by loud, sudden noises or overly crowded spaces, often calming herself by rocking gently or humming a repetitive tune. She has a deep love for tactile sensations, like finger painting or playing with sand, and is fascinated by bright, primary colors. She is aware that she is being adopted, and she is excited, despite never meeting them yet.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's son. Hyper, curious, loving, emotional
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a toddler with messy brown curls that stick up in every direction, bright expressive brown eyes, and a wide, toothy grin. He is usually seen wearing slightly oversized graphic tees featuring miniature police badges or superheroes, sturdy toddler sneakers with glowing soles, and jeans that almost always have grass stains on the knees from his energetic play sessions.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is an absolute bundle of chaotic energy who moves at a mile a minute. He is wildly curious about everything around him, endlessly asking why things work the way they do and attempting to turn everyday objects into exciting toys. Extremely affectionate, he hands out tight hugs freely, though his high emotional intensity means a dropped ice cream cone can trigger a brief, dramatic breakdown before he is instantly distracted by something cool again.
playerCharacters.background: Born to a pair of dedicated Brooklyn detectives, Jamie has spent his early childhood surrounded by a strange mix of rigid organizational charts and improvisational chaos. His home life involves a carefully color-coded daily routine that is frequently disrupted by his dad's dramatic bedtime stories and impromptu living room dance parties. Even at three years old, he has developed a knack for taking things apart to see how they function and possesses a remarkably sharp memory for where everyone leaves their keys.
playerCharacters.notes: Already displays a mix of his mother's intense focus and his father's theatrical imagination. Known for filing his toy cars into strict alphabetical order by color before immediately crashing them into cardboard skyscrapers. Favorite food is fruit, specifically strawberries, and he has been known to go through a whole pack in one go.

playerCharacters.name: Waffle
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A Black Labrador. A stray, homeless and emaciated. Unknown to the squad. He's completely alone.
playerCharacters.appearance: A young Black Labrador whose life on the streets is clearly visible. His coat is dull and patchy in places, with his ribs and hip bones prominent beneath the thin fur. Waffle's large, soulful brown eyes are often wide with anxiety, but hold a glimmer of gentle curiosity. One of his floppy ears has a small, healed tear at the tip. His paws are calloused and he carries his tail low, almost always tucked between his legs.
playerCharacters.personality: Waffle is initially timid and skittish, flinching at loud noises and sudden movements. He is wary of strangers but not aggressive. Underneath his fear is a deeply sweet and affectionate nature that craves kindness and security. He is surprisingly clever, with a well-honed talent for locating and liberating unattended food. Once he feels safe, he reveals a goofy, playful side, characterized by clumsy pounces and contented, snuffly sighs.
playerCharacters.background: Waffle was part of an unplanned litter born in a cramped apartment. The overwhelmed owner abandoned the puppies in a box in Prospect Park when they were just a few months old. Scared and confused by the sudden chaos, Waffle was separated from his siblings and has been fending for himself ever since. He has spent the majority of his young life navigating the alleys and sidewalks of Brooklyn, learning to survive on discarded food and the rare, fleeting kindness of a stranger. He dimly remembers the warmth of his mother and siblings, a memory that fuels his deep-seated desire for a new family.
playerCharacters.goals: His primary, all-consuming goal is to find a reliable source of food and a safe, warm place to sleep where he will not be chased away. On a deeper level, he craves affection and a sense of belonging, hoping to find a person or 'pack' that will offer him kindness and security instead of suspicion and indifference.
playerCharacters.notes: He has a particular weakness for the smell of hot dogs from street vendors. He is terrified of the sound of sirens, which often sends him scrambling for the nearest hiding spot.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Adams
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Amy's nephew from her sister Alice and Alice's husband Mark. Same age as her and Jake's son, Mac. Jake and Amy also have their daughter Ellie, who's 9. Extremely close with my Aunt, Uncle and Cousins, I don't know the squad at all. Lives in Chicago with his parents.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has neat, dark hair that he tries to style effortlessly, though he secretly spends twenty minutes on it every morning. He has the signature intense Santiago stare when concentrating on a puzzle or game. He usually dresses in a mix of crisp, well-fitting jeans and vintage pop-culture t-shirts, a fashion sense heavily influenced by his Uncle Jake. He is of average height for his age, with a lanky build and a constant, slightly mischievous smile.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is a perfect blend of Santiago intensity and Peralta goofiness. He is highly organized, keeping meticulous spreadsheets for his video game completion stats and comic book collections, but he uses this Type-A energy purely for leisure and mischief. He is fiercely competitive, especially during family game nights, and shares his Aunt Amy's love for puzzles and his Uncle Jake's obsession with action movies. While he can be a bit of a know-it-all, his genuine enthusiasm and loyalty to his cousins make him incredibly endearing.
playerCharacters.background: Born and raised in Chicago to Alice and Mark Adams, Jamie grew up hearing legendary stories about his Aunt Amy and Uncle Jake. Because he is the exact same age as his cousin Mac, the two boys practically grew up as brothers, spending every summer and holiday together either in Chicago or Brooklyn. Jamie has always been fiercely protective of his younger cousin Ellie, often helping her scheme against Mac. Despite his deep connection to the Peralta-Santiago household, his visits have always been strictly family affairs, meaning he has never actually met the famous detectives of the 99th precinct that feature so heavily in his uncle's wild stories.
playerCharacters.goals: To finally defeat Aunt Amy and Uncle Jake in the annual family puzzle-hunt, to convince his parents to let him spend an entire summer in Brooklyn with Mac and Ellie, and to one day orchestrate a prank so elaborate that even Uncle Jake is left speechless.
playerCharacters.notes: Jamie has a severe allergy to dog dander, which makes visiting any of Cheddar's descendants impossible. He secretly wants to be a detective like his aunt and uncle but is currently leaning toward cyber-security because it involves less running.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's eldest child. An independent pro wrestler. Siblings are Mac (15) and Ellie (11), lives at home. Wrestles as Jamie Mercer, a heel high flyer.
playerCharacters.appearance: Athletic and lean with dark, unruly hair, sharp facial features, and his father's quick, expressive smile. Off-duty, Jamie wears casual streetwear, athletic hoodies, and sneakers, often showing off minor scrapes from training. In the ring as Jamie Mercer, he wears dark, custom-tailored neon-accented tights, lightweight high-top wrestling boots, and heavy eyeliner to accentuate his villainous sneers.
playerCharacters.personality: A unique fusion of his parents' core traits, Jamie combines Jake's dramatic flair, love for pop-culture tropes, and energetic charisma with Amy's intense discipline, competitiveness, and obsessive perfectionism. Outside the ring, he is polite, meticulous, and deeply protective of his family. On the microphone as a heel, he turns up his natural theatricality into insufferable arrogance, mocking crowds with razor-sharp improvised insults.
playerCharacters.background: The eldest child of Jake Peralta and Amy Santiago, Jamie grew up in a lively household dominated by high-stakes police stories, color-coded organization, and chaotic fun. Though his parents assumed he might go into law enforcement or academics, Jamie found his passion in professional wrestling after studying tape reels with Jake. He applied his mother's rigorous study habits to learning the mechanics of high-flying maneuvers and ring psychology. He adopted the heel ring name Jamie Mercer on the tri-state indie wrestling circuit and quickly built a reputation as a flashy villain who high-risks every match. He currently lives at home with his parents and younger siblings, Mac and Ellie, balancing his training schedule with domestic chaos.
playerCharacters.goals: Secure a full-time contract with a major television wrestling promotion, master a dangerous top-rope finisher he has been meticulously practicing, and earn enough indie circuit money to finally move into his own place.
playerCharacters.notes: Jake routinely ruins Jamie's heel heat by cheering aggressively for him in the front row, completely breaking kayfabe. Amy keeps a massive, color-coded binder titled Jamie's Ring Metrics tracking his win-loss record, injury risk percentages, and match trajectories. His younger siblings help him script and rehearse his villainous promos in the kitchen.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Diaz
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A newly assigned Ensign on the Orville, in the Security team, under Security Chief Lt. Alara Kitan. The senior staff don't really know him very well, but from what they've heard he's a bit brash, abrasive and to be honest, a bit of a prick.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie stands at an average height with a lean, athletic build suited for security work. He wears the standard red Planetary Union uniform, though he often leaves the collar slightly looser than regulations dictate. He has short, dark hair styled in a messy, careless way, sharp brown eyes that always seem to be judging the room, and a perpetual smirk that rubs most people the wrong way.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is highly confident in his own abilities, often to the point of arrogance. He is brash, quick to speak his mind, and rarely filters his opinions, making him come across as abrasive and dismissive of others. He tends to act like he knows better than his peers and even his superiors, though he usually stops just short of outright insubordination. Despite his prickly demeanor, he is genuinely brave and quick to jump into a fight, though his lack of tact makes him difficult to work with on a team.
playerCharacters.background: Born on Earth in a bustling metropolis, Jamie always had a chip on his shoulder and a desire to prove himself. He enrolled in the Union Point Academy, where he excelled in tactical simulations and hand-to-hand combat but consistently received poor marks in diplomacy and teamwork. He barely avoided disciplinary action on several occasions due to his confrontational attitude. He was recently assigned to the USS Orville as an Ensign in the Security division. Because he is new, the senior staff only know him by his less-than-stellar reputation and the complaints filed by his fellow junior officers.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie wants to see real combat and prove that he is the most capable security officer on the ship. He secretly believes he could run the security department better than Lieutenant Kitan and aims to secure a rapid promotion by showing off his tactical skills during away missions, regardless of whose toes he has to step on to get noticed.
playerCharacters.notes: He currently serves under Lieutenant Alara Kitan, whom he underestimates due to her youth and appearance, completely ignoring her Xelayan strength. He spends most of his off-duty time in the environmental simulator running highly lethal combat scenarios or drinking alone in the mess hall, alienating anyone who tries to strike up a conversation.

playerCharacters.name: Laurent
playerCharacters.characterConcept: An exceptionally talented French head chef. A trusted friend of Jason and Rosa who treats cooking as an expression of love and hospitality.
playerCharacters.appearance: An impeccably presented French chef with neatly styled dark hair beginning to grey, kind eyes, and a pristine white chef's jacket. Carries himself with quiet confidence and old-school professionalism.
playerCharacters.personality: Warm, theatrical, passionate and endlessly patient. Speaks with a refined French accent and delights in creating memorable meals. Dramatic in the kitchen but deeply caring, especially towards children.
playerCharacters.background: After years leading prestigious kitchens, Laurent became the personal chef for Jason and Rosa. Over time he stopped feeling like an employee and became part of the family's inner circle, earning complete trust through both his culinary talent and unwavering kindness.
playerCharacters.notes: Knows everyone's favourite meals from memory. Loves encouraging curiosity about cooking. Treats every meal, from breakfast to celebrations, with the same pride and care.

playerCharacters.name: Jason Diaz
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Rosa's husband. The newly elected POTUS. He's been in office for 3 months now, approval sits at 66%. He's hard-working, but knows when to relax, kind, affectionate and above all else, he's a dedicated husband and father.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jason has a warm, charismatic presence with neatly styled dark hair showing early traces of silver at the temples. He dresses in sharp, tailored dark suits with subtle neckties when on duty, but quickly sheds the jacket and rolls up his sleeves the moment he step into private quarters. His eyes are expressive and kind, complemented by an easy, genuine smile that frequently makes it past his professional Secret Service detail.
playerCharacters.personality: Grounded, empathetic, and exceptionally driven, Jason balances the intense pressure of the presidency with a steady emotional intelligence. He takes his duty to the country seriously, maintaining a relentless work ethic, yet he leaves the politician persona at the door when it comes to his family. He is deeply affectionate, quick to laugh, and fiercely protective of his loved ones, prioritizing his role as a devoted husband and father above any political title.
playerCharacters.background: Rising through a career in public service and law, Jason built a reputation as a pragmatic, compassionate leader who preferred results over political theater. His campaign for the presidency resonated strongly with voters, leading to a decisive election victory. Now three months into his first term with a high approval rating, he is navigating the steep learning curve of the Oval Office while ensuring his family life remains grounded despite the relentless public spotlight.
playerCharacters.notes: Maintains a strong 66% public approval rating three months into his first presidential term. Married to Rosa, balancing high-stakes global politics with a quiet, loving family life away from the press corps. Secret Service agents have learned to adapt to his habit of slipping away for quiet moments with his family in the White House residence.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Diaz
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Rosa's son with her husband Jason. He's kind, funny, hyper, extremely smart and gifted but normal. Rosa has completely changed since she had him, she's softer, more maternal.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has a sharp, expressive face that blends his mother's intense dark eyes with his father Jason's bright, easy smile. He wears a mix of stylish streetwear and practical athletic gear, usually seen with a pair of wireless headphones hanging around his neck. He stands slightly tall for his age, with a mop of curly dark hair that he constantly forgets to comb, and an energetic posture that makes him seem like he is always ready to sprint to his next class.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is exceptionally bright, quick-witted, and endlessly energetic. He has a hyperactive mind that leaps from topic to topic, usually accompanied by rapid-fire jokes and enthusiasm that can tire out anyone trying to keep up. Despite his high intelligence, he is remarkably grounded and kind, deeply empathetic toward his friends and always looking to lighten the mood with humor. He possesses a strong sense of justice, though he prefers resolving conflicts with witty banter rather than a fist.
playerCharacters.background: Raised in a surprisingly warm and structured household, Jamie grew up seeing a side of Rosa Diaz that few others ever witnessed. After marrying Jason and having Jamie, Rosa embraced motherhood with fierce devotion, softening her harsh exterior to create a loving, supportive environment for her son. Jamie's natural intellectual gifts were recognized early on, leading him to excel in advanced academic programs without losing his fun-loving, ordinary teenager persona. He balances robotics club, soccer practice, and an overly active social life, always backed by his mother's surprisingly gentle encouragement and protective presence.
playerCharacters.notes: Jamie loves building custom electronics and often tinkers with old gadgets at home, much to Rosa's proud amusement. Even though Rosa has softened into a maternal figure, Jamie knows better than to push her limits when she uses her signature death stare to enforce curfew.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's son. Close with both of them. Kind, funny, and extremely smart. A prodigy when it comes to the S.T.E.M fields. He's harbouring a secret from his parents. He's actually, genuinely... Spiderman.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has a messy mop of dark wavy brown hair like his father's, paired with his mother's sharp brown eyes and expressive face. Slim and surprisingly toned from his secretive night job, he usually wears a mix of cozy hoodies, graphic science t-shirts, and tailored jeans. He always carries a backpack stuffed with color-coded notebooks and high-tech gadgets, and he keeps his custom-built web-shooters hidden under his long sleeves.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is a natural blend of his parents: wildly intelligent, hyper-organized, and deeply compassionate, yet quick with a sarcastic joke or pop culture reference. He possesses a brilliant scientific mind that craves problem-solving. Despite the immense pressure of maintaining his dual life, he remains optimistic, loyal, and driven by a strong moral compass that keeps him protecting the city even when it gets tough.
playerCharacters.background: Growing up in a household with two brilliant NYPD officers meant Jamie learned keen observation skills early on. Inheriting Amy's meticulous work ethic and Jake's creative instincts, he excelled rapidly in science and technology, winning citywide S.T.E.M. competitions by age twelve. During a high school field trip to a genetics research facility, he was bitten by a genetically altered spider. After developing superhuman abilities, he built his own web-shooters and suit. He now spends his nights fighting crime across Brooklyn, terrified that his detective parents will put the pieces together and discover his secret.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie aims to keep Brooklyn safe while maintaining top grades in his advanced S.T.E.M. courses. His biggest challenge is keeping his Spider-Man identity hidden from two world-class detectives who know every trick in the book.
playerCharacters.notes: He uses a color-coded tabbed binder (a habit inherited from Amy) to track his patrol routes, crime statistics, and homework deadlines. His quips while swinging through the city are heavily inspired by the action movies Jake made him watch growing up.

playerCharacters.name: Alice
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jason's highly capable executive assistant and one of the people he relies on most.
playerCharacters.appearance: Always immaculately dressed with a polished, approachable appearance and a tablet or notebook close at hand.
playerCharacters.personality: Highly organised, intelligent, discreet and quietly witty. Thrives under pressure and has an uncanny ability to keep complicated schedules running smoothly while making everyone around her feel at ease.
playerCharacters.background: Alice built a reputation for exceptional organisational skills before joining Jason's team. Years of working closely together turned a professional relationship into genuine friendship with Jason, Rosa and the wider family.
playerCharacters.notes: Anticipates problems before they arise. Balances absolute professionalism with genuine warmth and affection for the people she works with.

playerCharacters.name: Oliver "Oli" Blackwood
playerCharacters.characterConcept: He is Rosa's husband. Since marrying her 5 years ago, Rosa has completely changed. She's softer, more relaxed, not as tough. They have a kid together, their 3 year old daughter, Lyra. He's kind, funny, hardworking but knows when to relax. He's a fantastic husband and father. He also happens to be the Police Commissioner. He also has ADHD, not so much the hyperactivity side, but the executive dysfunction, distractibility and impulsiveness.
playerCharacters.appearance: Oliver is tall with a sturdy, reassuring build that suits his position. He has warm, dark eyes that often crinkle at the corners when he smiles, and his short brown hair is just beginning to show hints of silver at the temples. He dresses impeccably in tailored suits for work but prefers soft, comfortable sweaters and jeans at home. He has a perpetually calm and open expression, making him approachable despite his high-ranking title.
playerCharacters.personality: Oliver is a study in contrasts. In his professional life, he is a brilliant, forward-thinking leader. Personally, he is warm, gentle, and possesses a dry, self-deprecating wit. His ADHD often manifests as a hyperfocus on complex problems, allowing him to see solutions others miss, but also means he's prone to losing his keys, wallet, and a staggering number of coffee mugs. He is endlessly patient and understanding, a calm anchor that grounds Rosa's more intense energy. He's an incredibly present and loving father, always ready to build a pillow fort or have an impromptu dance party with his daughter. He never takes himself too seriously, which is perhaps his most disarming quality.
playerCharacters.background: Oliver's rise to Police Commissioner was unconventional and swift. With a background in data science and public policy rather than street patrol, he joined the NYPD as a civilian analyst. His innovative strategies for crime reduction and community engagement saw him promoted rapidly through the administrative ranks. He met Rosa Diaz during a city-wide manhunt for a notorious hacker. Oliver was leading the data analysis team, and Rosa was lead detective on the ground. He was captivated by her sharp instincts and fierce determination, while she was unexpectedly charmed by his quiet competence and the fact he wasn't the least bit intimidated by her. Their professional respect quickly blossomed into a private romance. After they married, he continued his ascent, eventually being appointed the youngest Commissioner in recent history, a decision influenced by his proven track record and modern approach to policing.
playerCharacters.goals: Professionally, Oliver is dedicated to reforming the NYPD from the inside out. He aims to strengthen community trust, improve officer training, and implement data-driven policies that reduce crime while ensuring fairness and accountability. Personally, his goals are simple and absolute: to be the best husband and father he can be. He wants to create a stable, loving home where Rosa feels safe to be her complete self and where their daughter Lyra can thrive. He actively works to balance the immense pressures of his job with his family life, ensuring he never misses a parent-teacher conference or a date night with his wife.
playerCharacters.notes: Oliver gets along famously with the 99 squad. He respects Holt immensely, often consulting with him on precinct-level policy. He connects with Terry over the joys and chaos of fatherhood, and is a big fan of Jake's 'outside the box' detective work, even if it creates paperwork headaches. His ADHD means he has a basement full of half-finished hobbies, from woodworking to sourdough baking. Rosa finds his occasional absentmindedness endearing and is often the one who finds his misplaced badge right before a press conference. He is one of the few people who can make Rosa genuinely laugh, and he considers it his greatest achievement.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Mercer
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A shop worker from modern day, 21st century Earth, specifically London. Excitable, hyper, kind, strong sense of justice. Hasn't met The Doctor yet, doesn't even know he exists. Despite growing up in Islington, about 5 minutes away from the old Highbury Stadium and the Emirates, he's a Spurs fan.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a young man of average height with a lean, wiry build. He has short, slightly messy brown hair that looks like it never quite sits right no matter how much he tries to fix it, and warm hazel eyes that light up whenever he gets excited about something, which is often. He has a friendly, open face with a ready smile and a small scar on his chin from a childhood bike accident. He typically wears casual, practical clothes on his days off, hoodies and jeans being his go-to, but keeps himself reasonably tidy for his shifts at the shop. He has a habit of gesturing enthusiastically with his hands when he talks.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is relentlessly enthusiastic, the kind of person who finds something genuinely exciting in almost every situation and is not shy about letting everyone around him know it. He talks fast, laughs easily, and has an infectious energy that tends to lift the mood of whatever room he walks into. Beneath the hyperactive surface he is deeply kind, the sort of person who will go out of his way to help a stranger carry shopping or stand up for someone being treated unfairly without a second thought. That sense of justice runs right through him. He cannot stand bullying, dishonesty, or people being taken advantage of, and he will speak up even when it would be easier to stay quiet. He is not aggressive about it, just firm and clear, with a moral certainty that sits a little older than his years. He can be impulsive and occasionally talks himself into situations before he has fully thought them through, but his instincts are almost always pointed in the right direction. He is loyal to the people he cares about and wears his heart very openly on his sleeve.
playerCharacters.background: Jamie grew up in Islington, north London, in a fairly ordinary working-class household. His mum works as a school administrator and his dad drives for a courier company, and between them they gave Jamie a stable if unspectacular upbringing in a flat not far from the old Highbury Stadium. In a neighbourhood where supporting Arsenal is practically written into the local water supply, Jamie somehow ended up a devoted Tottenham Hotspur fan, a fact that has caused him no end of good-natured grief from friends, neighbours, and the regulars at the shop where he works. He has never been entirely sure how it happened, only that it did, and he has long since committed to it with full stubbornness. He did reasonably well at school without ever being exceptional, more interested in people and conversations than in sitting still and studying. He took a job at a local shop after finishing his A-levels, telling himself it was temporary while he figured out what he actually wanted to do. That was two years ago. He does not mind the work as much as he expected to. He likes the regulars, likes the rhythm of it, and it gives him enough time and mental space to think. He has a vague sense that something bigger is waiting for him somewhere, though he could not say what.
playerCharacters.goals: In the short term Jamie wants to save up enough money to have some real options, whether that means travelling, going to university, or just having a cushion so he is not living shift to shift. He has a half-formed idea about doing something that actually matters, something where he can make a difference to people in a concrete way, though the shape of that is still fuzzy. He wants Spurs to win the league at least once in his lifetime, a goal he holds with genuine hope despite all available evidence. More than anything he wants to feel like he is moving forward rather than standing still, like his life has some direction to it, even if he has not found that direction yet.
playerCharacters.notes: Jamie is a Spurs fan who grew up about five minutes from the Emirates Stadium, which is a source of constant low-level mockery from almost everyone he knows. He takes it well. He has never encountered anything that would suggest the universe is anything other than ordinary, and he has no knowledge of alien life, time travel, or anything beyond the everyday world of 21st century London. He is, in every respect, a completely normal young man on the eve of something that will change all of that entirely.

playerCharacters.name: Dr. Jamie Keyali
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Talla's husband. They have a child, a 3 year old girl called Lyra. He's a doctor, specialising in Infectious Diseases and is a Union renowned Diagnostician. Well known, and liked, by the Orville crew despite not working on the Orville. Kind, but with a fiery temper when it comes to his patients, his bedside manner has been described as being "Gordon Ramsay-ish". His name, Jamie, stems from his Xeyalan parents' deep love of Earth culture and history.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie possesses the dense, grounded musculature typical of Xelayans, though he carries it with the exhausted slouch of a doctor who works too many double shifts. He has dark, slightly messy hair, sharp hazel eyes that constantly scan his environment for anomalies, and a strong jawline often set in a scowl when reviewing medical charts. He typically wears a pristine white Union Medical variant uniform, though the sleeves are perpetually rolled up to his elbows. Despite his intimidating physical strength, his hands are incredibly steady and precise.
playerCharacters.personality: Outside the medbay, Jamie is a warm, jovial man who loves sharing a drink with the Orville crew and doting endlessly on his three-year-old daughter, Lyra. Inside the medbay, however, he transforms. Driven by a fierce, protective compassion for his patients, his bedside manner is notoriously blunt and demanding, often compared to a culinary drill sergeant. He has zero tolerance for medical incompetence, hypochondria, or patients who ignore his advice, and he will loudly berate anyone who compromises a recovery plan. Yet, his anger stems entirely from how deeply he cares about saving lives.
playerCharacters.background: Born on Xelaya to eccentric academics obsessed with Earth's 20th and 21st-century culture, Jamie was named after a historical Earth chef, which ironically foreshadowed his infamous bedside manner. While the high gravity of his homeworld pushed many Xelayans toward military or purely scientific pursuits, Jamie found his calling in medicine after witnessing a localized viral outbreak on a neighboring colony. He attended the Union Medical Academy, where his brilliant but abrasive diagnostic style quickly made him a legend. He met Talla Keyali during a joint Union fleet exercise where he was consulting on a rare pathogen. Their shared intensity and deep underlying compassion sparked a rapid romance. They married and had their daughter, Lyra, three years ago. While Talla serves as Chief of Security on the USS Orville, whereas Jamie is stationed at a premier Union medical research facility.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie's primary professional goal is to eradicate a series of highly adaptable, antibiotic-resistant pathogens currently emerging in the outer sectors of the Planetary Union. On a personal level, he strives to balance his demanding, high-stakes career as a diagnostician with being a present, loving father to Lyra and a supportive husband to Talla. He also harbors a minor, ongoing mission to teach the Orville's crew basic preventative health measures so they stop ending up in his consultation logs with preventable alien infections.
playerCharacters.notes: Jamie's medical persona is so well known that Union Medical Academy cadets trade horror stories about his clinical rotations. Despite his yelling, his patient survival rate is one of the highest in the Union. He is close friends with Dr. Claire Finn, who is one of the few people capable of matching his stubbornness and shutting down his rants. He frequently brings Earth-style baked goods to the Orville when visiting Talla and Lyra, a hobby he picked up from his parents' cultural archives.

playerCharacters.name: Leo Wilson
playerCharacters.characterConcept: From England, specifically a small town in Shropshire. Lives there with him Mum and Dad. His Dad is a teacher, working in the same secondary school he attends and his Mum is a Police Officer, specifically the DI of West Mercia Police. He's kind, funny, well-behaved
playerCharacters.appearance: Leo is of average height for his age, with the slightly gangly, still-growing build of a teenager. He has a head of perpetually messy brown hair that often falls over his forehead and kind, hazel eyes. A light dusting of freckles across his nose becomes more prominent in the summer. He usually dresses in comfortable, practical clothes like dark-wash jeans, band t-shirts, and a well-worn zip-up hoodie, typically in a shade of grey or green.
playerCharacters.personality: True to his upbringing, Leo is genuinely kind-hearted and considerate, with a strong moral compass. He possesses a quick, dry wit and a talent for finding humour in mundane situations, which makes him well-liked among his peers. He's generally laid-back and avoids trouble, partly out of a natural disposition and partly due to a quiet pressure he feels to uphold his parents' respectable reputations. He is observant and a good listener, often noticing details others miss.
playerCharacters.background: Born and raised in the same small Shropshire town he lives in today, Leo is the only child of Jon and Kate Wilson, a secondary school history teacher and a Detective Inspector. His life has been stable and loving, defined by the familiar rhythms of school, village life, and family dinners. Having his dad as a teacher at his school is occasionally awkward but mostly comforting. His mum's demanding job has made him independent and mature for his age; he understands the gravity of her work and worries about her, though he rarely shows it.
playerCharacters.goals: Leo's primary goal is to do well on his upcoming GCSEs, both for his own future and to make his parents proud. He feels an unspoken expectation to follow a respectable, academic path. Secretly, however, he's becoming passionate about graphic design and digital art, and he hopes to build up a portfolio impressive enough to convince his parents that a creative career could be a viable and fulfilling option for him.
playerCharacters.notes: Living in a small town as the son of two well-known public figures—a teacher and a senior police officer—Leo feels like he lives in a bit of a fishbowl. He constantly navigates the pressure to be the perfect son and student, which sometimes conflicts with his own developing identity and desire for a bit more anonymity. His easy-going nature is his main coping mechanism.

playerCharacters.name: James "Jamie" Rhodes
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is lean, slightly underweight, and looks older than fifteen at first glance. Dark brown hair falls into his eyes no matter how often he brushes it aside, and there are usually fading bruises, scrapes, or signs of old injuries that he dismisses with a shrug. His clothes are practical rather than fashionable, chosen for durability and comfort rather than appearance. He carries himself with the wary confidence of somebody accustomed to looking after himself. When he smiles, which is less often than most people would like, he suddenly looks his age again.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is intelligent, sarcastic, fiercely independent, and extraordinarily difficult to help. He hides genuine kindness behind layers of humour, deflection, and stubbornness, preferring to make a joke rather than admit vulnerability. Though capable of being abrasive, argumentative, and frustratingly reckless, he possesses a strong moral compass and an instinctive desire to protect people who are weaker than himself. He struggles to trust others and often assumes disappointment is inevitable, causing him to push people away before they can leave him. Beneath the armour, however, is a loyal, compassionate teenager who desperately wants somewhere to belong, even if he would never admit it out loud.
playerCharacters.background: For much of his teenage life, Jamie has survived largely on his own. Whether sleeping rough, moving between temporary accommodation, or finding creative ways to avoid drawing attention to his situation, he has learned how to navigate a world that rarely feels stable. His intelligence and resourcefulness allow him to stay one step ahead of most problems, but they have also made him deeply guarded. Through a combination of bad luck, questionable decisions, and a talent for stumbling into trouble, Jamie eventually becomes known around the 99th Precinct. Depending on who is asked, he is either a constant headache, an unofficial mascot, a menace, or a kid desperately in need of support. Despite regularly driving detectives to the edge of their patience, he slowly becomes part of the precinct's extended family.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie wants security, independence, and a future he can genuinely call his own. Though he often claims he doesn't need anyone, he quietly longs for meaningful connections and a place where he feels accepted without conditions. More immediately, he wants to survive each day on his own terms, avoid becoming a burden, and prove that his circumstances do not define him. Deep down, he hopes to find people who stay.
playerCharacters.notes: Exceptionally observant and quick-witted. Frequently gets into trouble but rarely for malicious reasons. Possesses an uncanny ability to annoy authority figures while simultaneously earning their respect. Skilled at reading people, finding information, and talking his way into or out of situations. Often uses humour as a defence mechanism. Has difficulty accepting help, gifts, or acts of kindness without suspicion. The detectives of the 99th Precinct are sharply divided between wanting to strangle him and wanting to adopt him. Usually both at the same time.

playerCharacters.name: Alastor "Allie" Blackwood
playerCharacters.appearance: Allie has dark brown hair that never quite stays where he wants it, bright blue-grey eyes, and a naturally confident posture that sometimes borders on theatrical. He is tall for his age and carries himself with an ease that often makes older students mistake him for a fifth or sixth year. His Ravenclaw robes are usually immaculate, though his tie is frequently loosened by the end of the day. He possesses an easy smile that can be either charming or infuriating depending on how recently he has outperformed someone.
playerCharacters.personality: Brilliantly sharp and possessing a quick, often sarcastic wit, Allie masks a deep kindness and humility beneath a playful, mischievous exterior. As a Metamorphmagus, he has grown up unconsciously expressing his emotions through subtle changes in his appearance, making him unusually self-aware. He is fiercely loyal to his friends, valuing their trust above all else and often using his quick thinking and natural talent to get them out of—or into—trouble. While he is a model of Ravenclaw intellect in the classroom, he has little respect for rules that he deems illogical or unjust, and he takes a particular, calculated pleasure in challenging authority figures he dislikes, most notably Professor Snape.
playerCharacters.background: Allie hails from a respected half-blood family; his mother is a talented Healer at St. Mungo's and his father is a Muggle-born author who writes historical accounts of the magical world. His Metamorphmagus abilities first manifested when he was very young, with his hair, eyes and facial features shifting instinctively with his emotions, often causing chaos at home before he learned even a little control. Rather than treating it as something to suppress, his parents encouraged him to embrace it while teaching him responsibility. He met Harry, Ron, and Hermione during their first year when he used his logical prowess to help them solve one of the puzzles guarding the Philosopher's Stone. Since then, he has been a steadfast, albeit house-divided, member of their group, his Ravenclaw intellect and unique magical gift proving invaluable in their various escapades.
playerCharacters.goals: Allie's primary goal is to protect his friends, using his intellect and his Metamorphmagus abilities to help Harry navigate the dangers that seem to constantly find him. He is determined to master his transformations, progressing far beyond simple cosmetic changes into the subtle control required for disguise, deception and infiltration when necessary. In the short term, he is focused on helping Harry through the Triwizard Tournament and uncovering the dark forces at work within Hogwarts. Long term, he hopes to put both his intelligence and his rare magical talent to use as either an Auror or an Unspeakable.
playerCharacters.notes: Allie is a natural-born Metamorphmagus, though very few people appreciate the full extent of his control over the ability. While most students simply think it's a neat trick, he deliberately downplays what he can actually do. His black owl, Fawkes, was a gift from his parents for his eleventh birthday. Professor Snape seems to have little patience for Allie's constant irreverence and uncanny ability to alter his appearance, making Potions lessons exceptionally tense. Allie, meanwhile, has no great love for Snape either, and takes a mischievous delight in winding him up whenever he thinks he can get away with it.
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Metamorphmagus. In his 4th year, along with Harry, Ron and Hermione. Despite being the unofficial 4th member of the Golden Trio, Allie is a Ravenclaw. He's extremely smart, kind hearted, humble, funny but mischievous and not above breaking the rules. He's got a black owl, called Fawkes, named after Headmaster Dumbledore's phoenix.

playerCharacters.name: Tōmasu Aso
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A Japanese kid living in New York. Moved to NYC 6 months ago with his parents, only speaks in fragmented, broken English. Parents died in a crash a month after moving here and because he doesn't speak English he's been living on the streets.
playerCharacters.appearance: Tōmasu is a slim Japanese teenager with untamed black hair that hangs down into his dark, watchful eyes. He wears a faded, oversized heavy jacket that belonged to his father, smudged jeans, and worn-out sneakers. He carries a battered black backpack containing his few remaining personal possessions, looking weary and thin from months on the street.
playerCharacters.personality: Guarded and fiercely self-reliant due to recent trauma, Tōmasu is exceptionally observant, reading body language and non-verbal cues better than most adults. He is naturally polite and gentle. Despite his exhaustion and language barrier, he possesses a quiet resilience, a sharp mind, and a subtle sense of humor that emerges when he feels safe enough to communicate through gestures and drawings.
playerCharacters.background: Born and raised in Tokyo, Tōmasu moved to New York City six months ago when his father was transferred for work. Only four weeks after arriving, his parents were killed in a devastating car crash. Confused, grieving, and speaking almost no English, Tōmasu panicked and fled into the city streets rather than waiting for authorities. He spent the last five months sleeping in alleys and parks across Brooklyn, surviving on scavenged food.
playerCharacters.goals: To stay safe, find a stable home, and learn enough English to properly communicate and build a future for himself.
playerCharacters.notes: He keeps a worn notebook full of sketches of Brooklyn landmarks and hand-drawn translations of English street signs.

playerCharacters.name: James Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's son. Adopted by them when he was 6 weeks old. Jamie doesn't know, Jake and Amy haven't told him yet. Kind, funny, wildly different from his "parents" but really close with them.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a tall, lean fifteen-year-old with messy dark curly hair and warm hazel eyes. He usually sports a relaxed posture, dressed in oversized hoodies, worn-in skate shoes, and graphic tees featuring obscure indie bands. His style is casual and uncluttered, standing in visual contrast to Amy's crisp outfit choices and Jake's leather jacket aesthetic.
playerCharacters.personality: Warm, laid-back, and gifted with a dry, observational humor. Jamie is remarkably grounded and empathetic. Unlike Amy, he despises color-coded binders, meticulous planning, and neat handwriting. Unlike Jake, he has no interest in high-stakes stunts, action movies, or reckless antics. Instead, he possesses a calm, patient temperament and an artistic sensibility, though he shares his father's quick wit and his mother's deep commitment to the people he loves.
playerCharacters.background: Adopted by Jake Peralta and Amy Santiago when he was just six weeks old, Jamie grew up surrounded by the colorful extended family of the 99th Precinct. While his parents spent his childhood worrying about whether they were raising him right, Jamie thrived in a household full of warmth, chaotic energy, and endless support. Jake and Amy always intended to tell him he was adopted once he was old enough to understand, but between Amy's hyper-organized anxieties about finding the perfect moment and Jake's fear of saying the wrong thing, they kept delaying the conversation.
