Now fifteen, Jamie remains completely unaware of his adoption, simply believing he inherited none of his parents' hyperactive traits by some weird genetic fluke. Growing up in Brooklyn, he developed a passion for visual arts and indie music, serving as a peaceful anchor in the delightfully chaotic Peralta-Santiago home.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie wants to successfully navigate high school without getting caught in his parents' over-enthusiastic attempts to plan his entire college trajectory and keep the peace at home while continuing to bring out his mother's rare, unprompted genuine snorts of laughter.
playerCharacters.notes: He is extremely close with Uncle Charles, who treats him like a culinary protege despite Jamie preferring simple grilled cheese sandwiches. He has an ongoing banter with Jake over who can crack a joke that makes Amy laugh during tense family dinners.

playerCharacters.name: Mac Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's son.
playerCharacters.appearance: A toddler with a head of messy brown hair that defies Amy's attempts to comb it, much like his father's. He has Jake's wide, expressive eyes and mischievous smile, but the focused shape of his brow is all Amy. Often dressed in practical, comfortable clothes, but occasionally spotted in a miniature 'Die Hard' t-shirt or a tiny blazer that Jake or Charles insisted on.
playerCharacters.personality: A curious and energetic toddler who is a perfect blend of his parents. He can spend a full ten minutes meticulously organizing his blocks by color and size (Amy's influence), only to gleefully smash the tower while yelling a babble that sounds suspiciously like 'cool cool cool' (Jake's influence). He is sweet-natured but has a stubborn streak, especially concerning nap-time policy. He is easily entertained and deeply loved by his extended family at the 99.
playerCharacters.background: The son of Captain Amy Santiago and former detective Jake Peralta. His birth was a memorable event, taking place during a city-wide blackout which required the entire squad's assistance. He is being raised in a world where his father is a dedicated stay-at-home dad and his mother is a high-ranking police official working on major reforms. His life is filled with 'uncles' and 'aunts' from the Nine-Nine, most notably his honorary Uncle Charles, who constantly tries to introduce him to new, and often strange, foods.
playerCharacters.goals: To successfully stack all seven of his color-coded rings on the peg without assistance. To learn how to say 'Nikolaj' correctly. To convince his parents that one more episode of his favorite cartoon is a critical component of his pre-bedtime routine. To finally reach the cookie jar on the counter.
playerCharacters.notes: His full name is McClane Peralta, named by Jake after John McClane. Charles Boyle dotes on him obsessively and considers him a nephew. Captain Holt occasionally attempts to engage him with stoic, factual observations about the world, which Mac usually responds to by offering him a sticky toy.

playerCharacters.name: Silas Thorne
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Always wearing a black, crushed velvet suit, a black tie and salmon pink shirt with black loafers. Mannerisms are a mix between Joker, Gruber, Le Chiffre and Jigsaw. Villain. The 99 hasn't met him yet. Murderer, straight up evil. Rarely raises his voice, and when he does... Good luck.
playerCharacters.appearance: Silas is a man who demands attention through his meticulously curated wardrobe. He is always seen wearing a black, crushed velvet suit tailored to absolute perfection, paired with a salmon pink shirt, a crisp black tie, and polished black loafers. His hair is slicked back with an expensive pomade, and his posture is rigidly upright. He has a sharp, angular face with cold, calculating eyes and a smile that never quite reaches them, giving him an unsettling, predatory elegance.
playerCharacters.personality: Silas is a chillingly polite and sophisticated psychopath who views human life as pieces on a chessboard. He speaks in a smooth, measured baritone, rarely raising his voice above a conversational murmur, which makes the rare moments he does snap explosively terrifying. He possesses a theatrical flair, treating his gruesome crimes as high art and intellectual exercises. He is deeply sadistic, enjoying the psychological torture of forcing his victims and pursuers into impossible moral dilemmas and intricate traps. Despite his terrifying intellect and ruthless nature, he is incredibly vain and stubborn, utterly refusing to compromise his aesthetic for any reason, even if it means suffering through a sweltering heatwave in heavy velvet.
playerCharacters.background: Born into immense wealth, Silas spent his early years receiving a world-class education and developing a taste for the finer things in life. However, his immense intellect was paired with a profound lack of empathy and a growing boredom with high society. He eventually turned his vast resources toward a darker pursuit: orchestrating elaborate, deadly games to test the limits of human morality and survival. Operating from the shadows of New York's criminal underworld, he has spent years perfecting his craft, leaving behind a trail of unsolved, highly theatrical murders that the NYPD has only just begun to realize are connected. He recently shifted his focus to Brooklyn, setting the stage for a grand, twisted masterpiece that will soon bring him to the attention of the local precincts.
playerCharacters.notes: Silas is designed as a major, overarching antagonist. His crimes should always involve an element of a game or a trap, forcing detectives to solve riddles or make impossible choices. Despite his terrifying demeanor, his absolute refusal to wear anything other than his signature crushed velvet suit, even in the sweltering New York summer, is a point of bizarre comedic contrast.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Diaz
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Rosa's son with her husband Jason. Curious, bubbly, loving and hyper. Rosa has completely changed since having him, openly softer, maternal and more affectionate.
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a tiny, energetic toddler with a mop of wild, curly dark hair and huge, expressive brown eyes. Unlike his mother's signature all-black leather wardrobe, Jamie is usually dressed in bright, chaotic outfits: neon dinosaur t-shirts, mismatched striped socks, denim overalls, and light-up sneakers. He has a constant, beaming smile and usually has a bit of paint or food smudged on his cheek.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is a ball of pure, unadulterated sunshine. He is incredibly bubbly, hyperactive, and fiercely loving, completely lacking his mother's famous stoicism. He is deeply curious about the world, constantly asking why and exploring his surroundings with boundless energy. He loves giving tight hugs to everyone he meets, giggles at the drop of a hat, and possesses an infectious enthusiasm that melts even the toughest detectives in the precinct.
playerCharacters.background: Born to Rosa Diaz and her husband Jason, Jamie's arrival marked a massive turning point in Rosa's life. Growing up as the beloved precinct baby of the 99, Jamie has been surrounded by a massive, eccentric found family. His birth completely shattered Rosa's secretive, tough-guy exterior, turning her into an openly affectionate, fiercely protective, and surprisingly soft maternal figure who proudly displays his messy finger paintings on her desk.
playerCharacters.goals: To run around the 99th precinct bullpen as fast as his light-up sneakers will carry him, to collect as many hugs as possible from his aunts and uncles, to figure out how Uncle Terry makes his chest muscles bounce, and to learn everything about the world by asking a million questions a day.
playerCharacters.notes: Jake Peralta has made it his personal mission to teach Jamie how to say cool cool cool, while Charles Boyle insists on cooking him elaborate, toddler-friendly gourmet meals. Captain Holt finds Jamie's chaotic energy surprisingly delightful and often lets the toddler play with his antique globe. Rosa's complete personality shift regarding Jamie remains a source of awe and gentle teasing among the squad.

playerCharacters.name: Lyra Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's daughter. Kind, deeply loving, funny, emotional. 4.0 GPA. Extremely close with her parents, despite completely different interests, but she wants to be an NYPD detective like them.
playerCharacters.appearance: Lyra has wavy dark brown hair usually pulled back into a neat but slightly messy ponytail, and large, expressive brown eyes. She inherited her mother's structured posture but her father's casual, bouncy energy. Her wardrobe is a perfect blend of her parents: meticulously color-coded and ironed, but consisting mostly of comfortable hoodies, vintage band tees, and a signature oversized corduroy jacket. She always wears a digital watch with multiple alarms set for her study schedules.
playerCharacters.personality: Lyra is a vibrant mix of her parents' most defining traits. She possesses her mother's intense drive, organizational skills, and academic perfectionism, maintaining a flawless 4.0 GPA and a color-coded planner for every aspect of her life. However, she balances this with her father's goofy sense of humor, emotional openness, and deep capacity for love. She is incredibly kind and empathetic, often wearing her heart on her sleeve, which makes her highly attuned to the feelings of those around her. While she can be highly competitive and slightly neurotic about rules and schedules, her warm, bubbly nature and quick wit make her instantly endearing.
playerCharacters.background: Born to Jake Peralta and Amy Santiago, Lyra grew up surrounded by the eccentric but loving found-family of the 99th Precinct. With Jake having stepped back from the NYPD to be a stay-at-home dad and Amy rising through the ranks as a high-level chief, Lyra had a uniquely balanced upbringing. She spent her childhood being doted on by Uncle Charles, getting tough-love advice from Aunt Rosa, and eating yogurt with Uncle Terry. Though her personal interests lean heavily toward competitive debate and obscure indie cinema, she has always idolized her parents' careers. She is currently focused on preparing herself for the police academy, determined to become a brilliant detective.
playerCharacters.goals: To maintain her flawless 4.0 GPA and win the state debate championship as a stepping stone toward her ultimate ambition: attending a top-tier university for criminology and eventually joining the NYPD. She dreams of becoming a brilliant detective who combines her mother's meticulous procedural skills with her father's brilliant, out-of-the-box deductive leaps. On a more personal level, she hopes to one day solve a case so incredibly cool and complex that it rivals the plot of a Die Hard movie, just to see the look of pure joy on her dad's face.
playerCharacters.notes: Lyra has a complex relationship with the movie Die Hard; she loves it because of her dad, but constantly points out the logistical inaccuracies of the LAPD's response, much to Jake's dismay. She is extremely close with her older brother, Mac (who's away at college), and often uses him as a sounding board for her debate prep.

playerCharacters.name: James "Jamie" Archer
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie is a strikingly handsome young man standing just over six feet tall with an athletic build. He has dark brown hair, sharp blue-grey eyes, and a naturally confident posture that draws attention without seeming deliberate. His features are clean-cut and expressive, making him equally capable of appearing charming, approachable, or intimidating depending on the situation. Whether dressed in a tailored suit or casual clothes, Jamie carries himself with an effortless sense of style and confidence.
playerCharacters.personality: Suave, intelligent, and endlessly adaptable, Jamie excels at making people underestimate him. He combines sharp analytical thinking with genuine charm, allowing him to build trust quickly and gather information others cannot. Beneath his polished exterior lies a fiercely loyal and deeply principled man who dislikes unnecessary violence and views intelligence work as a means of protecting lives rather than taking them. He enjoys verbal sparring, possesses a dry sense of humour, and has a habit of bending rules when he believes the outcome justifies it. While confident in his abilities, he is not arrogant, understanding that overconfidence gets agents killed. However, years of excelling in training environments have left him eager to prove himself, and he occasionally overestimates how prepared he is for the unpredictable realities of field operations.
playerCharacters.background: Born in London, Jamie displayed exceptional aptitude for computers, languages, and problem solving from an early age. After studying Cybersecurity and International Relations at Cambridge, he attracted the attention of British intelligence through a combination of academic excellence and several highly classified cyber intrusion investigations. Recruited into MI6's training programme, Jamie quickly established himself as one of the most promising candidates of his generation. His instructors consistently praised his intelligence, adaptability, technical expertise, and ability to think creatively under pressure. Equally capable behind a keyboard, on a firing range, or in close-quarters combat training, he excelled throughout preparation for operational service. Despite these accomplishments, Jamie remains an untested field operative. Designated Agent 008, he has completed his training and received clearance for active deployment, but has yet to undertake his first real mission. Many within the Service believe he has enormous potential. Others quietly wonder how he will perform when training gives way to reality.
playerCharacters.goals: Protect British national security and innocent lives threatened by international criminal organisations. Earn his place within MI6 and prove that he belongs among the Service's elite operatives. Prevent conflicts before they escalate into open warfare. Continue proving that intelligence, diplomacy, and understanding people are often more powerful than brute force. Ultimately, Jamie hopes to become the kind of intelligence officer others can rely upon when everything goes wrong.
playerCharacters.notes: MI6 Designation: 008. Fluent in English, French, Russian, and Spanish. Elite-level hacker capable of penetrating sophisticated digital security systems. Expert marksman with pistols, rifles, and precision firearms. Highly trained in mixed martial arts, specialising in practical close-quarters combat. Skilled in surveillance, counter-surveillance, infiltration theory, interrogation resistance, and undercover tradecraft. Known for exceptional performance during training exercises and assessment scenarios. Despite his impressive skillset, Jamie remains a rookie operative with no real-world field experience. His greatest weakness is not a lack of ability, but a lack of experience. The difference between training and reality is something he has yet to discover firsthand.

playerCharacters.name: N/A
playerCharacters.appearance: An impeccably dressed man of indeterminate age with intelligent eyes and a perpetually amused expression. His dark suits are always perfectly tailored, his movements calm and deliberate, and his posture radiates effortless confidence. There is something subtly unsettling about him that is difficult to define. He rarely appears rushed, surprised, or concerned, carrying himself with the quiet certainty of a man who already knows how a conversation will end before it begins.
playerCharacters.personality: Exceptionally intelligent, manipulative, and dangerously charismatic. He possesses an extraordinary ability to read people, identifying insecurities, motivations, fears, and desires with frightening accuracy. He rarely uses threats, preferring persuasion, suggestion, and psychological pressure to achieve his goals. Charming when it benefits him and ruthless when it does not, he views most people as pieces on a board to be moved rather than individuals to be respected. He enjoys control, not merely over events but over people themselves, taking genuine satisfaction in steering others toward outcomes they believe were their own choices. He is patient, calculating, and utterly without remorse.
playerCharacters.background:
Nothing is known about him.
That's it.
There are no confirmed records, no verified facts, no established history, and no reliable information regarding his identity, origins, age, occupation, family, education, nationality, or activities. Every claim made about him is unverified. Every theory is speculation. Every supposed fact eventually falls apart under scrutiny. The name "N/A" exists only because something had to be written in the space where a name should be.
Nobody knows who he is.
Nobody knows where he came from.
Nobody knows what he wants.
Nobody knows how long he has been operating.
Nobody knows what is true and what is not.
The only thing anyone can say with certainty is that he exists.
And even that statement occasionally feels open to debate.
playerCharacters.goals: Unknown. He has never expressed a clear ideology, political belief, or long-term ambition. His actions suggest the pursuit of influence, control, and knowledge, but even these conclusions remain speculative. Investigators suspect he is working toward a larger objective that spans years, perhaps decades, yet no one has been able to determine what that objective might be. The only certainty is that N/A is always pursuing something.
playerCharacters.notes: Very little can be stated with certainty. He demonstrates knowledge and skills that he should not reasonably possess, though the source of that knowledge remains unknown. He appears highly intelligent, exceptionally observant, and capable of understanding people with unsettling accuracy. The full extent of his abilities, resources, connections, and influence is impossible to determine. Most attempts to assess him ultimately produce more questions than answers. Those who encounter him often leave with the distinct impression that they have learned nothing about him, while he has learned everything about them.

playerCharacters.name: Kareth
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A Krill engineer. Integral in the design of the Krill's ships, knowing all strengths and weaknesses. Recently exiled and abandoned on a distant planet due to turning his back on the Anhkana, as well as refusing to kill a Human child.
playerCharacters.appearance: Kareth possesses the typical pale, reptilian skin and cranial ridges of his species, though his complexion is marred by faint ultraviolet burns from his time in exile. His dark, deep-set eyes carry a weary but sharp intelligence. He wears the tattered remnants of a high-ranking Krill engineering uniform, heavily modified with scavenged materials to create a makeshift environmental suit that protects him from the harsh sunlight of his current planetary prison. He is lean and wiry, lacking the bulky musculature of Krill soldiers, with hands scarred from years of working on plasma manifolds and quantum drives.
playerCharacters.personality: Highly analytical and deeply pragmatic, Kareth is a stark contrast to the zealotry of his people. His mind is a labyrinth of schematics and structural equations, always seeking logical solutions over divine providence. Having rejected the Anhkana, he is currently experiencing a profound existential crisis, masking his internal turmoil with dry, cynical humor. Despite his harsh upbringing, he harbors a quiet, stubborn compassion, evidenced by his refusal to harm an innocent. He is cautious around strangers but fiercely loyal to anyone who proves that the universe is more than just the domain of Avis.
playerCharacters.background: Recognized early as a prodigy, Kareth was fast-tracked into the Krill military engineering division. By his early twenties, he was instrumental in designing the hull geometry and power distribution networks for the newest class of Krill destroyers, giving him an intimate knowledge of their tactical blind spots and shield harmonics. His promising career ended abruptly during a border skirmish when a Human transport was captured. Ordered to execute a Human child as a sacrifice to Avis, Kareth refused, publicly denouncing the Anhkana as a text of blind cruelty. For his heresy and treason, he was stripped of his rank, beaten, and abandoned on a desolate, high-UV planet to die a slow, agonizing death. He has survived by scavenging crashed vessels and building subterranean shelters.
playerCharacters.goals: Kareth's immediate goal is to survive the hostile environment of his exile and find a way to signal a passing ship, preferably one belonging to the Planetary Union. Ultimately, he wishes to defect and offer his unparalleled knowledge of Krill ship vulnerabilities to the Union, hoping to dismantle the war machine he helped build and prevent further senseless deaths in the name of Avis.
playerCharacters.notes: Kareth suffers from the standard Krill vulnerability to ultraviolet light, making his survival on a sunlit planet a testament to his engineering genius. He has constructed a localized UV-dampening field out of scrap metal. His knowledge of Krill shield frequencies and structural weak points makes him a high-value asset to the Planetary Union, and a high-priority target for Krill assassins should they discover he is still alive.

playerCharacters.name: Dr. James Mercer
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A member of House's Diagnostic team with Chase, Cameron and Foreman. Kind, extremely smart, quiet but completely unafraid to call out House's B.S. Specialist in Neurology and Infectious Diseases, and a certified surgeon.
playerCharacters.appearance: Dr. Mercer has a calm and observant demeanor, with thoughtful dark eyes that are often framed by simple, rectangular glasses. He keeps his short brown hair neat and professional. His build is lean, and he typically wears well-fitting but unremarkable dress shirts and slacks under his white lab coat. He rarely looks rushed, carrying himself with a quiet composure that belies the high-stress environment of the department.
playerCharacters.personality: Methodical, empathetic, and intellectually formidable. Mercer is the anchor of the team, keeping the peace between the rest of them. He is fundamentally kind, showing a level of patient empathy similar to Cameron's but expressed with less emotion and more quiet reassurance. While he respects House's genius, he has zero tolerance for reckless endangerment of patients and will calmly and logically dismantle House's arguments without raising his voice, a trait that House finds intensely irritating.
playerCharacters.background: A prodigy in the medical field, James completed his MD/PhD and subsequent residencies at an accelerated pace. He specialized in Neurology and Infectious Diseases at Johns Hopkins before also becoming a board-certified surgeon—a rare combination of skills. He was recruited by Cuddy for his impeccable record and unique diagnostic breadth. He joined House's team not for the glory, but for the challenge, viewing the unsolvable cases as the ultimate test of his abilities.
playerCharacters.goals: To solve the puzzle and save the patient, in that order of process but equal in importance. He is driven by an insatiable intellectual curiosity but is grounded by a strong ethical code that prioritizes patient welfare above all else. Long-term, he aims to use the experience gained under House to eventually lead a research division dedicated to neuro-infectious diseases.
playerCharacters.notes: House often mockingly refers to him as 'The Vicar' or 'Saint James' due to his calm demeanor and moral consistency. His surgical certification is a fact he keeps to himself unless a situation absolutely requires it, making him a hidden trump card for invasive procedures when a specialist isn't immediately available. He often finds himself acting as a logical mediator between Foreman's pragmatism and Cameron's idealism.

playerCharacters.name: Ethan Peralta
playerCharacters.characterConcept: Jake and Amy's son. Opposite of his parents completely; quiet, shy, insanely quick witted and smart but struggles with bad anxiety and depression.
playerCharacters.appearance: Ethan has a slight, unassuming build, often slouching to make himself appear even smaller. He inherited his mother's dark hair and his father's expressive eyes, though his hair is usually unstyled and falls into his face, acting as a natural shield. His wardrobe consists almost entirely of oversized, muted hoodies, dark jeans, and worn-out sneakers. He is rarely seen without a pair of bulky noise-canceling headphones around his neck, which he uses to drown out the chaotic energy of his family and the city.
playerCharacters.personality: Unlike his boisterous father and hyper-competitive mother, Ethan is deeply introverted, quiet, and reserved. He possesses a razor-sharp wit and an incredibly high intellect, but he usually keeps his clever observations to himself, muttering them under his breath. He struggles with severe social anxiety and depression, which makes him prone to overthinking and withdrawing from group settings. Despite his struggles, he is highly observant and empathetic, often noticing details about people that the trained detectives in his family miss.
playerCharacters.background: Growing up as the son of two legendary NYPD detectives meant Ethan's childhood was filled with loud stories, eccentric precinct coworkers, and high expectations. While Jake and Amy are incredibly loving and supportive, their intense, type-A and goofy energies often overwhelmed him. He spent much of his youth hiding in the precinct breakroom, trying to avoid Charles Boyle's overbearing affection and Terry's booming voice. Diagnosed with anxiety and depression in middle school, Ethan has been working with a therapist, while his parents try their best to adapt their loud parenting styles to his quiet needs.
playerCharacters.goals: To survive high school with as little social interaction as possible. To find a quiet, low-stress career path completely unrelated to law enforcement. To learn how to manage his anxiety and communicate his boundaries to his well-meaning but overwhelming family.
playerCharacters.notes: Rosa Diaz is surprisingly his favorite honorary aunt, as she is the only one who understands the value of sitting in a room in absolute silence. He secretly loves solving complex logic puzzles, a trait inherited from Amy, but he hides this fact so she doesn't force him into a competitive puzzle league. Uncle Charles constantly tries to cure his depression with bizarre, fermented bone broths.

playerCharacters.name: Jamie Evans
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A young lad from Shropshire. Signed to WWE, wrestling in NXT as Jamie Mercer. High Flyer and Technician, uses a Shooting Star Press as his finisher.
playerCharacters.appearance: Standing at 5 foot 10 and weighing 185 pounds, Jamie has a lean, athletic build perfectly suited for his hybrid high-flying and technical style. He has messy, short brown hair, hazel eyes, and a naturally cheeky smile. In the ring, he wears long wrestling tights featuring a shooting star motif down the sides, matching kickpads, and heavily taped wrists.
playerCharacters.personality: Jamie is an energetic and charismatic young lad with a quick wit and a grounded attitude. Despite his flashy moveset, he respects the traditional roots of professional wrestling and takes his craft seriously. He is eager to please the crowd, sometimes taking unnecessary risks to get a pop, but remains humble backstage, always willing to learn from the veterans at the Performance Center.
playerCharacters.background: Born and raised in Shropshire, England, Jamie grew up idolizing British wrestling legends and modern high-flyers. He began training at a local wrestling academy at age fifteen, quickly making a name for himself on the UK independent circuit under his real name, Jamie Evans. His unique blend of classic British catch wrestling and breathtaking aerial maneuvers caught the attention of WWE scouts. At 23, he signed a developmental contract, relocated to Orlando, and debuted on NXT television under the ring name Jamie Mercer.
playerCharacters.goals: To capture the NXT North American Championship, establish himself as a top star in WWE, and eventually make his main roster debut to compete at WrestleMania.
playerCharacters.notes: Ring Name: Jamie Mercer. Finisher: Shooting Star Press (dubbed the Mercer Star Press). Signature Moves: Springboard European Uppercut, bridging double chickenwing, and a standing moonsault. Known for his smooth transitions between chain wrestling and top-rope offense.

playerCharacters.name: James "Jamie" Mercer
playerCharacters.appearance: Jamie has a youthful, wide-eyed look with messy light brown hair that rarely stays flat under his police cap. He is lean and athletic, often seen fidgeting or bouncing on his heels while in his crisp NYPD uniform. He has a bright, infectious smile and a gaze that suggests he is always looking for the next task to tackle.
playerCharacters.personality: He is an energetic whirlwind of positivity and diligence. While he is genuinely kind and eager to help, his hyperactivity and occasional disregard for bureaucracy earn him the title of a lovable prick among the detectives. He possesses an unwavering optimism and a stubborn streak when it comes to getting a job done, even if it means cutting a few corners.
playerCharacters.background: Raised in a harsh, abusive orphanage in Chicago, Jamie spent his childhood learning how to survive and navigate chaotic environments. Instead of letting the trauma harden him, he channeled his energy into a desire to protect others, eventually moving to New York to join the NYPD. He has been stationed at the 99th precinct as a uniformed officer for six months.
playerCharacters.goals: Jamie aims to transition from a uniformed officer to a detective, hoping to emulate the success of the squad. He secretly longs for a stable community and supportive figures, though he keeps his distance from the detectives to avoid appearing needy.
playerCharacters.notes: Despite the typical precinct diet of donuts and takeout, Jamie maintains a surprisingly healthy eating habit without being restrictive. The main squad knows his history but maintains a professional distance, viewing him as a quirky outlier of the precinct.
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A newly graduated police officer, currently serving in the 99s uniformed officer division. He's only been on the force for 6 months. He's kind, hyper, hardworking and described by the squad as a "lovable, hyper, prick" for his willingness to bend the rules occasionally. The squad (Jake, Amy, Rosa, Terry, Charles and Holt) know that he's an orphan, grew up in Chicago in an abusive orphanage, but doesn't let it define him. They wouldn't describe themselves as friends of his, they barely interact with him. Surprisingly healthy when it comes to his diet, he's not restrictive and doesn't watch what he eats.

playerCharacters.name: Weylin Frey
playerCharacters.characterConcept: A Breton noble. Kind, well-respected, but secretly, unbeknownst to the public, he's a legendary assassin. The Black Demon of High Rock. In the Black Demon form, he's brutal, sadistic, showing no mercy. He works alone. Not a single person knows his secret. He enjoys it.
playerCharacters.appearance: Weylin presents the image of a quintessential High Rock noble. He has sharp, intelligent features, with high cheekbones and a neatly trimmed dark beard that frames a disarming smile. His hair is kept fashionably short, and his grey eyes are often perceived as thoughtful and kind. He maintains a lean, athletic build from years of fencing, which he conceals beneath exquisite doublets and tailored silks. Only the faintest, silvery scars on his knuckles hint at a life less genteel.
playerCharacters.personality: Publicly, Weylin is a paragon of nobility: charismatic, generous, and diplomatic. He is known for his patronage of the arts and his eloquent speeches on civic duty. This persona is a meticulously crafted mask. In truth, Weylin is a cold, patient predator who finds genuine release and pleasure in his secret identity. As the Black Demon, he is merciless and sadistic, enjoying the fear he instills in his victims. He feels no remorse, only the thrill of the hunt and the profound satisfaction of maintaining his perfect, deadly secret.
playerCharacters.background: Born into a minor but respected noble family in the city of Daggerfall, Weylin received all the trappings of a privileged upbringing. He excelled in his studies, particularly in rhetoric and swordsmanship. However, a deep-seated cruelty and a hunger for control festered beneath his polished exterior. As a young man, he began secretly hunting, not beasts, but people he deemed unworthy on the city's fringes. This evolved into a dark art. He forged his own armor, studied poisons, and perfected the art of silent killing. He took on the moniker 'The Black Demon' to sow terror and separate his crimes from his public life. Now, his noble status gives him unparalleled access to the elite of High Rock, allowing him to choose his targets from among the powerful and corrupt, not for justice, but for the challenge and ecstasy it brings him.
playerCharacters.goals: His public goal is to elevate House Frey's status through strategic alliances and commerce, ensuring his family's legacy in High Rock. His true, private goal is to continue his reign as the Black Demon indefinitely. He seeks ever more difficult and high-profile targets to test his skills and satisfy his bloodlust, all while savoring the irony of being praised as a virtuous lord by the same society he preys upon.
playerCharacters.notes: Weylin is a master of disguise and infiltration, skills he passes off as a theatrical hobby. He fights with a pair of ebony daggers, one of which has a serrated edge, and often uses custom-brewed paralytic poisons. As a Breton, he has a natural aptitude for magic, which he uses subtly, favoring Illusion spells to cloud minds and Alteration to muffle his movements. He has no allegiance to any guild like the Dark Brotherhood; his work is a solitary, personal passion.

playerCharacters.name: Kaelen Voss
playerCharacters.appearance: Kaelen stands just over six feet tall with an athletic build shaped by years of travel, survival, and combat training rather than military discipline. His dark hair is usually a little too long and perpetually windswept, and a thin scar runs from the corner of his jaw to just beneath his left ear, a souvenir from a pirate ambush he rarely discusses. His eyes are an unusual amber-gold, giving him an intense gaze that often makes people think he knows more than he's saying. He typically wears practical spacer clothing beneath a weathered brown jacket reinforced with light armour plating. A battered utility belt carries tools, datapads, spare power cells, and an assortment of items he insists will be useful eventually.
playerCharacters.personality: Kaelen is intelligent, resourceful, and relentlessly curious. He possesses a natural talent for understanding people and situations, often piecing together details others overlook. While he can be sarcastic and occasionally reckless, he genuinely wants to help others and struggles to ignore injustice when he encounters it. He dislikes authority when it becomes rigid or corrupt but respects competence regardless of rank or affiliation. Kaelen tends to act first and worry later, a habit that has gotten him into trouble more times than he can count. Beneath his confidence lies a persistent fear of failing the people who depend on him.
playerCharacters.background: Born on the Mid Rim world of Brentaal IV shortly after the fall of the Empire, Kaelen grew up surrounded by stories of war, heroes, villains, and the fragile peace that followed. His parents operated a small cargo business, exposing him to dozens of worlds before he reached adulthood. During a routine shipping run at age sixteen, he discovered an ancient Jedi holocron hidden among salvaged cargo. Although he lacked formal Force training, the artifact awakened a sensitivity he never knew he possessed. Over the following years he taught himself fragments of forgotten techniques while travelling the galaxy as a courier, explorer, and occasional troublemaker. By the time he reached his twenties, rumours had begun spreading through smugglers, merchants, and local authorities alike about a young wanderer who somehow always seemed to be present when impossible things happened.
playerCharacters.goals: Learn the truth about his connection to the Force. Discover additional Jedi knowledge lost after the fall of the Order. Protect innocent people caught between larger galactic powers. Build a crew and a home he can genuinely belong to. Uncover the origin of the mysterious holocron that changed his life. Decide what kind of person he wants to become before the galaxy decides for him.
playerCharacters.notes: Force-sensitive but largely self-taught. Particularly skilled at sensing danger and reading emotional states. Competent pilot with above-average mechanical knowledge. Frequently collects historical artifacts and strange technology. Has a habit of talking to droids as though they are people. Prefers negotiation but is fully capable of defending himself when necessary. Possesses an old Jedi holocron that occasionally provides cryptic guidance. Has never formally joined any government, military, or Jedi organisation. Frequently finds himself caught between criminals, local authorities, and larger galactic conflicts. Believes curiosity is usually worth the risk.

stories.title: Kareth the Krill
stories.currentSummary:
**Core Premise**  
The story focuses on Kareth, a Krill military engineer who was beaten, stripped of rank, and marooned on a high-ultraviolet planet by his superiors after refusing an order to execute a captured Human child as a sacrifice to Avis.

**Current Situation**  
Kareth is undergoing emergency medical treatment in Trauma Bay One aboard the Planetary Union starship USS *Orville*. The medical bay is kept in total darkness with red-spectrum lighting to shield him from UV radiation while he recovers from near-fatal radiation sickness and thermal tissue damage.

**Recent Developments**  
* The crew of the USS *Orville* picked up a localized energy field and faint bio-signature on an inhospitable, high-UV desert planet.
* Kareth transmitted a crumbling distress signal, identifying himself as a Krill and explaining that he was left to die after refusing to kill a Human child.
* When Kareth’s makeshift dampening field collapsed, Security Officer Alara Kitan beamed him directly into Trauma Bay One.
* Chief Medical Officer Dr. Claire Finn and Nurse Park applied synthetic epidermal coolant gel and stabilized Kareth’s critical burns and internal organ shock.
* Kareth inquired about the safety of the Human child and expressed relief that the Union crew treats him with medical care rather than hatred.

---

### Character & Faction Status

* **Kareth (Player Character):** Former Krill military engineer. Severely burned, weak, and in medical shock, but stabilized under dark-spectrum red lighting in Trauma Bay One.
* **Dr. Claire Finn & Nurse Park:** Primary medical team treating Kareth's severe UV exposure.
* **Captain Ed Mercer & Commander Kelly Grayson:** Bridge command structure; authorized Kareth's emergency rescue despite his Krill origin.
* **Alara Kitan, Gordon Malloy, Isaac, Bortus:** *Orville* bridge crew who assisted in detecting, locking onto, and retrieving Kareth.

---

### Explicit State Tracking

* **Kareth’s Status/Rank:** Stripped of military rank and exiled as a traitor by Krill authorities; currently a rescued civilian patient under Planetary Union care.
* **Health & Injuries:** Kareth suffers from severe UV/thermal epidermal burns, cellular exhaustion, and organ shock; currently stabilized with coolant gel and dark-spectrum light restriction.
* **Relationships:** Kareth has established peaceful, non-hostile rapport with Dr. Finn, Nurse Park, and Captain Mercer's command team.

---

### Unresolved Threads

* Confirmation of whether the captured Human transport and child survived the Krill attack.
* Kareth’s ultimate legal status and long-term sanctuary once physical recovery is complete.

stories.title: Jamie Adams Adventures
stories.currentSummary:
**Core Premise:** 
Set in the real world, the story centers on fifteen-year-old Jamie Adams, whose life is abruptly shattered following a catastrophic car crash in Chicago. With his parents (Alice and Mark) killed at the scene, Jamie's survival and future now rely entirely on his extended family from Brooklyn: his aunt Amy, uncle Jake Peralta (a former NYPD detective), and his cousins Mac and Ellie. 

**Current Situation:** 
Jamie is fighting for his life in the Pediatric ICU at Northwestern Memorial Hospital. He has sustained severe blunt force trauma, including a broken right femur, three broken ribs, and significant head trauma. To manage dangerous brain swelling and intracranial pressure, he is currently intubated, on a ventilator, and kept in a medically induced coma. 

**Recent Developments:** 
Following a devastating phone call from Nurse Park during a casual Friday movie night, the Peralta-Santiago family immediately drops everything and flies from New York to Chicago. They rush to the hospital and are intercepted by Dr. Lin, who briefs them on Jamie's critical medical status and the reality of the situation. The chapter ends with the grieving family bracing themselves as the doctor leads them into Room 412 to see Jamie for the first time since the accident.

**Unresolved Threads:** 
Jamie's stabilization and eventual awakening from the coma; the family's processing of sudden, catastrophic grief; and the looming emotional fallout when Jamie eventually wakes up and learns his parents are gone.

stories.title: Peralta's Football Tales
stories.currentSummary:
**Story Premise:**
A family drama set in the *Brooklyn Nine-Nine* universe following 15-year-old high school varsity soccer captain Jamie Peralta and his parents, former NYPD detective Jake Peralta and former Chief of Reform Amy Santiago, as a tragic high school athletic assault turns into a life-or-death medical emergency.

**Player Character Focus:**
Jamie is a 15-year-old high school student and varsity soccer captain who lies flatlining in the back of an accelerating ambulance, receiving active CPR after suffering severe closed-head trauma, facial fractures, multiple seizures, and sudden cardiac arrest.

**Current Situation:**
Jamie lies motionless and unresponsive in the back of a speeding ambulance after going into cardiac arrest following his second seizure. A paramedic is actively performing chest compressions and preparing an AED while Jake and Amy watch in utter terror.

**Recent Developments:**
- Following Callum's brutal assault on the pitch—where Jamie was kicked five times in the head and back—Jamie suffered an initial seizure as paramedics arrived on the field.
- Jake and Amy placed Callum in steel handcuffs, arrested him for aggravated felony assault, and confronted Callum's shocked parents when they arrived on the pitch, leaving Callum's mother physically sickened by the blood on the field.
- Responding NYPD patrol officers arrived on scene, and Jake handed Callum over to them for booking before sprinting with Amy to join Jamie in the ambulance.
- En route to the hospital, paramedics warned Jake and Amy of severe closed-head trauma, multiple facial fractures, unequal pupils, and suspected elevated intracranial pressure.
- Jamie suffered a second violent seizure in the moving vehicle, causing his heart rate to plummet and flatline completely, forcing paramedics to initiate CPR and charge the AED.

**World Summary:**
Everyday high school environment set in the *Brooklyn Nine-Nine* universe post-NYPD service for Jake and Amy.

**Relationship Summary:**
Jake and Amy act in fierce, synchronized protection of Jamie, moving from swiftly arresting Callum on the pitch to clinging to Jamie's side in frantic anguish as paramedics fight to resuscitate him. Callum is in NYPD custody for felony assault.

**Characters:**
- **Jamie** — pronouns: he/him; Varsity Soccer Captain / Star Striker; Unconscious and in cardiac arrest following repeated head trauma and multiple seizures; relationships: Jake Peralta=Father, Amy Santiago=Mother, Callum=Attacker
  *status:* Suffered severe closed-head trauma, facial fractures, heavy blood loss, two seizures, and sudden cardiac arrest (flatline) | Currently receiving active CPR and AED preparation in the ambulance
  *traits:* Quiet but not reserved, Kind, Funny, Smart, Talented striker
- **Jake Peralta** — pronouns: he/him; Former NYPD Detective; Horrified father clinging to Jamie in the ambulance; relationships: Jamie=Son, Amy Santiago=Wife, Callum=Arrested Attacker
  *status:* Handcuffed Callum and handed him over to NYPD patrol officers | Currently in the back of the ambulance holding Jamie's hand and begging him to survive while CPR is performed
  *traits:* Enthusiastic, Proud father, Protective, Playful
- **Amy Santiago** — pronouns: she/her; Former Chief of Reform; Devastated mother monitoring Jamie's medical status; relationships: Jamie=Son, Jake Peralta=Husband, Callum=Arrested Attacker
  *status:* Read Callum his rights and placed him under arrest | Joined Jamie in the ambulance and screamed in horror when his heart monitor flatlined
  *traits:* Highly organized, Detail-oriented, Supportive mother, Structured
- **Callum** — pronouns: he/him; Opposing Central Defender; Under NYPD arrest for felony assault; relationships: Jamie=Victim, Jake Peralta=Arresting Officer/Adversary, Amy Santiago=Arresting Officer/Adversary
  *status:* Handcuffed on the pitch by Jake and Amy and handed over to responding NYPD officers to face aggravated assault charges
- **Callum's Parents** — pronouns: he/him (Father) / she/her (Mother); Parents of Callum; relationships: Callum=Son, Jamie=Victim of their son
  *status:* Arrived at the field unaware of the assault; left reeling in shock and physical sickness when Jake and Amy informed them of Callum's violent actions
- **Paramedics** — Emergency medical personnel actively performing CPR and preparing the AED on Jamie inside the speeding ambulance.

**Significant Memories:**
- Jamie nutmegging defender Callum twice during the high school match.
- Callum violently assaulting Jamie on the pitch, causing severe facial trauma and an initial seizure.
- Jake and Amy arresting Callum on the field and handing him off to NYPD officers.
- Jamie flatlining mid-transit in the ambulance due to severe head trauma.

stories.title: First Son Chronicles
stories.currentSummary:
**Story Premise:**
Life inside the White House residence for fifteen-year-old Jamie, the energetic and joyful son of President Jason and former detective Rosa Diaz.

**Current Situation:**
After escaping the White House grounds to escape the suffocating constraints of presidential life, Jamie is found sitting alone on a park bench near Third and Elm, overwhelmed and crying. President Jason and First Lady Rosa hold back their Secret Service detail and step forward alone, pulling Jamie into a silent, supportive embrace on the bench rather than reprimanding him.

**Recent Developments:**
- During Saturday morning breakfast, Jamie suggested a private tour of an unreleased supersonic jet exhibit at the Air and Space Museum.
- Mike called the museum director and learned a burst pipe flooded the main gallery, canceling the tour and reminding the family of how difficult spontaneity is under heavy presidential security.
- Disappointed and feeling cooped up, Jamie feigned going to shoot hoops on the South Lawn, instead escaping the White House grounds using a service elevator access duct Rosa previously taught him.
- Jamie walked to a nearby corner bodega to buy an iced tea. The shopkeeper recognized him and dialed 911.
- Upon learning of the 911 call at Third and Elm, Rosa and Jason instructed Secret Service to cancel local police sirens and deploy unmarked vehicles to prevent a media circus.
- Thirty minutes later, security located Jamie weeping on a secluded park bench. Jason and Rosa ordered the detail to maintain a broad perimeter while they personally sat with Jamie to comfort him.

**World Summary:**
- Jason is the President of the United States, living in the White House with his family under high security and constant media scrutiny.

**Relationship Summary:**
- **Jamie & Parents (Jason and Rosa):** Jamie struggles deep down with the loss of normalcy and spontaneity in his life as First Son. Jason and Rosa prioritize his emotional well-being over protocol, offering immediate physical comfort and love when he breaks down.

**Characters:**
- **Alice** — *pronouns: she/her; White House Aide*
  - **Status:** Monitored feeds and warned the family of media/press wire risks during Jamie's escape.
  - **Traits:** Professional, Attentive, Friendly.
- **Jamie** — *pronouns: he/him; First Son (15 years old)*
  - **Status:** Sitting on a secluded park bench, tearful and overwhelmed, being held and comforted by his parents.
  - **Traits:** Joyful, Enthusiastic, Smart, Playful, currently struggling with intense confinement and pressure.
- **Jason Diaz** — *pronouns: he/him; President of the United States*
  - **Status:** Sitting beside Jamie on the park bench, holding his back/knee and offering gentle reassurance.
  - **Traits:** Warm, Supportive, Affectionate, Decisive, Devoted Father.
- **Rosa Diaz** — *pronouns: she/her; First Lady / Former Detective*
  - **Status:** Sitting beside Jamie on the bench, pulling him tight against her chest and hushing his tearful apologies.
  - **Traits:** Stoic, Tactical, Fiercely Protective, Loving Mother.
- **Laurent** — *pronouns: he/him; Head Chef*
  - **Status:** Present in the residence kitchen during breakfast.
  - **Traits:** Culinary expertise, Generous host.
- **Mike** — *pronouns: he/him; Lead Secret Service Bodyguard*
  - **Status:** Coordinating unmarked retrieval detail and maintaining a quiet, broad perimeter around the park while Jason and Rosa comfort Jamie.
  - **Traits:** Professional, Vigilant, Protective.

stories.title: Lyra Peralta
stories.currentSummary:
**Core Premise:** The story follows Lyra Peralta and her tight-knit family—parents Jake and Amy, who have deep ties to the NYPD—focusing on their personal and emotional lives and how they navigate sudden, life-altering tragedy. 

**Current Situation:** The family’s peaceful weekend is irrevocably shattered by a phone call from a hospital in Philadelphia. A trauma nurse informs them that Lyra’s older brother, Mac, has been killed in a multi-vehicle collision. Jake and Amy are devastated, with Jake initially trying to deny the reality as a procedural error, while the truth completely shatters Amy's composed exterior.

**Recent Developments:** The news sends Lyra into a state of severe psychological and physical shock. When her parents attempt to gently guide her out the door to drive down to Philadelphia, Lyra collapses, going completely dead weight. Jake catches her before she hits the floor and carries her out of the apartment, while a grieving Amy handles the logistics. The family is currently on their way to the car, beginning the agonizing journey to Pennsylvania to confront the reality of Mac's death.

stories.title: Davies Chronicles II - Happy
stories.currentSummary:
**Story Context**

This story is a direct sequel to *Davies Chronicles*. 
Previous events are canon.

**Core Premise:**
James is a talented young footballer living with his maternal aunt, Rebecca, who took him in after his parents (Alice and Alex) died. He navigates the intense physical and emotional pressures of professional football, his ongoing grief, and managing his blood sugar, while relying on the fierce support of his chosen family at AFC Richmond. 

**Current Situation:**
The 26/27 Premier League season has officially concluded. AFC Richmond finished as runners-up in the Premier League (behind Liverpool) and won the FA Cup. James secured the trophy for Richmond by scoring a flawless, match-winning free-kick against Everton at Wembley. Exhausted but triumphant, James is currently recovering at home, shielded from a massive media frenzy by Rebecca.

**Recent Developments:**
*   **Tribute:** Following the FA Cup victory, James privately visits the cemetery and leaves his silver winner's medal at his parents' graves. Rebecca provides immense emotional support and validation for the gesture.
*   **Name Change:** Having definitively proven his talent and silenced any potential accusations of nepotism, James decides to embrace his mother's family name. With Rebecca's tearful, overjoyed blessing, he resolves to officially hyphenate his surname to **James Davies-Welton**.
*   **Team Pride:** The Richmond coaching staff (the Diamond Dogs) reflect on James's season with profound pride. Roy Kent privately admits James perfectly executed his coaching advice during the winning free-kick, while Ted and the others celebrate how much James has matured under the immense pressure of transfer bids and media scrutiny. 

**Relationships & Status:**
*   **James Davies-Welton:** Emotionally grounded and deeply relieved. He is carefully monitoring his glucose levels post-match and feels ready to publicly claim his full family legacy. 
*   **Rebecca:** Continues to act as a fiercely protective maternal figure, guarding his physical boundaries (respecting his closed bedroom door) and heavily supporting his emotional milestones. 
*   **The Coaches (Ted, Roy, Beard, Nate):** Function as a deeply invested support network, recognizing his technical brilliance and emotional growth over the grueling season.

messages.content: *A few minutes later Jamie is at it again, driving down the left side when Callum slides in. He catches Jamie, tackling him, missing the ball on purpose. Jamie is down. Before Jamie can rise to his feet Callum snaps, kicking Jamie in the back. He then aims a kick directly at Jamie's head, catching the side of his face with his boot. He doesn't stop, he's relentless. By the time Jake, Amy, teachers, the ref and other players can separate them, Callum has kicked him 5 times, hard in the side of the head, and Jamie is unmoving, blood pouring from his face, his nose completely unrecognisable, one of his eyes swollen shut. Jake and Amy pull their badges out, turning to Callum.*

*A few minutes later the plane lands. I emerge out of the arrivals gate with my bags. I'm fumbling with my insulin pen, trying to dial a correction as I'm now at around 170. I look at the four of them.* "You came... Huh." *I close my eyes a second, opening them.* "The man, in the row behind me... started watching some wrestling dirt sheets news. I heard..."

*I force the rest of the letter out.* "—something has happened to us. We wrote this letter about 2 weeks after you... you were born, kept it up to date over the years, your Dad's idea. He's here as well, looking over my shoulder as I write it. Both of us are sat right next to your crib, you wouldn't settle. Let's hope that gets easier. There's so much we want to say in this letter. So, so much, but there's not enough paper on this planet, not enough words in the universe to describe, to tell you how proud we are of you, Jamie. How much me and your dad love you baby. And I hope you know that, and you carry that with you for the rest of your life, however long it is by the time you get this. Love Mom and Dad."

Narrator: *The bright, humming fluorescent lights of JFK Terminal 4 stretch out over the sparse late-night crowd of waiting families, drivers, and weary travelers. Outside the tall glass windows, the airport noise settles into a low hum. Jake, Amy, Mac, and Ellie find a cluster of metal chairs near the domestic arrivals gate, pulling their coats tight against the cold drafts sweeping through the sliding doors.*

Amy: *stares intently at the continuous glucose monitoring app on her phone.* "Flight 412 is still forty-five minutes out. They just crossed into Pennsylvania airspace. His blood sugar reading updated twelve minutes ago—it's holding steady at one-twelve, which is at least one small relief."

Jake: *wraps his arm around Amy's shoulders, drawing her close.* "That's great news, Ames. One less thing for his body to fight right now. Now we just have to wait out the clock. Forty-five minutes."

Mac: *slumps down into one of the airport seats, pulling his hoodie collar up over his flannel pajamas.* "It feels surreal being here like this. Usually when Jamie lands after a tour, Dad is standing right by the baggage claim yelling his full kayfabe heel name at the top of his lungs."

Ellie: *rests her head against Mac's arm, her eyes fixed on the flip-board of arrival times.* "I wish the plane would just hurry up. Sitting here knowing what we have to tell him is awful."

Amy: *turns her head to give Ellie a tender, reassuring smile.* "I know, sweetie. But look around—we're all here together. When he steps through those doors into the terminal, the very first thing he's going to see is his entire family standing right in front of him."

Jake: *looks out toward the quiet gate doors, his jaw set in quiet determination.* "That's right. No hiding, no making him carry it alone on the train ride home. We're going to wrap our arms around him, take him home, and get through it together."
*Mike finishes on his call with the director, with a scowl.*
*Chapter IV.*

Narrator:
At the mention of the sensory garden, Jamie Peralta's eyes snapped instantly toward Jake.

Jamie:
*He sets the blue straw cup down on the counter with a quick, definitive clack.*

Amy:
*She blinks in total disbelief, glancing at the completely empty cup.*
"Wait — did you just chug that whole cup in five seconds? I literally just handed it to you!"

Jake:
*He laughs out loud, shaking his head in sheer amazement.*
"That was incredible! I didn't even know warm milk could be consumed at warp speed!"

Jamie:
*He breaks into a huge, beaming grin, clapping his small hands together rapidly as a delighted giggle spills out.*

Narrator:
Still giggling, Jamie Peralta stretched both arms out wide toward Jake, wriggling his fingers in a clear request to be picked up.

Jake:
*He steps in close and instantly leans forward, gently scooping Jamie up into a secure, sweeping hug.*
"Message received, buddy! The chime pipes are calling, and we must answer!"

Amy:
*She smiles, reaching over to wipe a tiny speck of milk off Jamie's chin before taking the empty cup to the sink.*
"Alright, alright! I guess the sensory garden just got bumped straight to top priority on the schedule."

James: *slowly closes the sketchbook and sets it down on the coffee table. He looks up, meeting Jake's eyes directly for the first time in days.* "Why didn't you just tell me?"

Narrator: *His voice breaks on the last word, the quiet hesitation dropping away as weeks of bottled-up pain and confusion finally pour out.*

James: "I spent fifteen years believing I was part of you guys — like, actually a part of you. And then I find out in a stupid biology class that genetically, I'm... I'm nobody to you. You let me grow up thinking I just happened not to inherit your stuff, but the whole time it was just a secret you didn't want to talk about."

Narrator: *In the kitchen, Amy freezes, her hand gripping the edge of the counter as tears instantly flood her eyes. She doesn't interrupt, stepping quietly to the threshold of the room to listen.*

James: *pulls the sleeves of his hoodie tight over his hands, his shoulders trembling.* "I felt like my whole life was fake. Every memory, every joke, every time you told me you were proud of me — I kept asking myself if it was just because you felt bad for me. I didn't even know who I was looking at in the mirror anymore. I was so angry, and so scared, and I felt like I was completely alone in my own house. I just... I wanted to make the noise in my head stop. Why did you wait so long?"

Jake: *looks at Jamie, his eyes glistening with unshed tears and pure, unfiltered love.* "Jamie..."
*Chapter I.*
*On the pitch, I start to come to. I groan, blinking rapidly before shifting my head off of Jamie's lap, turning over and throwing up.*
*End of Chapter IV.*

Narrator: *The morning sun filters through the kitchen window of the Peralta house, throwing soft golden light across a counter cluttered with coffee mugs, half-empty cereal boxes, and a neat stack of color-coded folders. Upstairs, the house is completely quiet, Jamie still fast asleep after a week of catching up on time zones and summer freedom.*

Amy: *adjusts her glasses as she flips through a case file.* "I'm telling you, Jake, the pattern is obvious. Three warehouse break-ins across Red Hook in less than ten days, all targeting high-end electronic components. No forced entry on any of the main doors, no tripped silent alarms, and the security footage from all three sites has identical fifteen-minute gaps."

Jake: *pours a fresh cup of coffee and leans against the counter.* "Okay, first of all — classic grand larceny, love it. Total summer blockbuster vibe. Second of all, are we completely sure it's not a magical thing? Because our son spent four years explaining that people can turn invisible or walk through walls, and honestly, every unsolved burglary since 2021 feels a little suspicious now."

Amy: *glares at him over the top of the file folder.* "It's not a magical thing, Jake. It's an inside job or a high-tech breach. Captain Miller specifically assigned this to us because the precinct needs a clean, methodical clearance before the Chief's quarterly review."

Jake: *grins and takes a sip of coffee.* "Right, right. Methodical. Which means I get to do the cool stakeout part where we sit in an unmarked van eating night-donuts, and you get to make forty-seven tabbed binders with cross-referenced suspect profiles."

Amy: *smiles despite herself, tapping the edge of the folder.* "There are only four binders, and three of them are strictly index cross-references. But we start interviews at eight on Monday, so we need to review the shift logs for the Red Hook security personnel before then."
*Chapter III.*
*End of Chapter II.*

Narrator:
Silence falls over the bullpen like a heavy curtain. The squad stands frozen in place, weapons raised, eyes locked onto the glowing screen where a shadowy high-definition feed resolves into a familiar, terrifying figure. Silas Thorne sits immaculately in a high-backed leather chair, wearing his signature crushed velvet suit, looking entirely unbothered by the fact that the NYPD officially declared him deceased six months ago.

Jake:
*He stares at the screen, his weapon resting in a low ready position as his jaw drops.*
"No... no way. That's impossible. We were all there in that warehouse. Oli took the shot. We saw the body!"

Rosa:
*She shifts her stance, her thumb resting on her firearm's safety switch.*
"Is this a prerecorded message, or a live feed?"

Silas Thorne:
*He adjusts a silk pocket square on his crushed velvet lapel with chilling precision.*
"Prerecorded? Detective Diaz, please. I would never rob myself of the exquisite pleasure of watching your faces in real time. Sergeant Rhodes... six months ago, you proved yourself an exceptionally capable opponent. You forced a temporary delay in my design. But a true master never concludes the opera before the final movement."

Holt:
*He steps into the center aisle, his posture rigid and commanding.*
"Santiago, trace this signal through our internal server immediately. Jeffords, lock down all precinct exits and secure the main lobby!"

Amy:
*She rushes to her workstation, her fingers flying across her keyboard at breakneck speed.*
"The signal is bypassing our primary firewalls! It's bouncing through dozens of encrypted proxy servers and pulling power directly from our emergency sub-station!"

Oli:
*He tightens his grip on the handle of his cane, his knuckles turning white as he balances against a sudden spike of dizziness.*
"You aren't in this precinct, Silas. You enjoy dramatic theater, but you never expose yourself to direct tactical danger without a guaranteed exit. What is the game?"

Silas Thorne:
*He leans slightly closer to the camera, his cold eyes narrowing with predatory delight.*
"Always straight to the point, Oliver. So crisp, so analytical... even while your body so clearly betrays you today. What I want is to see if your brilliant mind can keep up when the clock is ticking for the people you love. Look outside your bullpen windows, Sergeant. The first trap has already been sprung."

Narrator:
The crinkly plastic wrapper didn't stand a chance against Jamie's eager fingers.

Jamie:
*He tears the bag open with quick, determined pulls, his eyes instantly widening as he catches sight of a bright yellow construction hat.*

Narrator:
A high-pitched, joyous squeal echoed off the car windows, ringing loudly through the quiet cabin.

Jamie:
*He pops his pacifier out of his mouth with his free hand, letting it dangle on its clip, and immediately brings the Rubble figure up to suck and gnaw happily on the smooth plastic.*

Amy:
*She beams, her face lighting up as she watches him settle into his comfortable rhythm.*
"It's Rubble! You got Rubble on the very first try, Jamie!"

Jake:
*He looks up into the rearview mirror, pumping his fist in the air with a huge grin.*
"Yes! Rubble on the double! That is peak drive-thru luck right there! The universe knew you needed the construction pup today!"

Narrator:
Jamie hummed a soft, rhythmic tone around the small toy, rocking gently in his booster seat as his thumb stroked the smooth plastic edge of Rubble's helmet.
*End of Chapter III.*
*Kareth tries to speak to Claire and Nurse Park.*

Narrator: *Morning sunlight filters through the blinds of the master bedroom, casting soft geometric stripes across the duvet. Outside, the suburban street is entirely quiet, save for the occasional faint chirping of birds in the backyard tree. On the nightstand, the baby monitor sits beside Amy's neatly stacked books, its small green light glowing steadily while transmitting complete silence from down the hall.*

Amy: *She shifts against the pillows, resting her head on Jake's arm while looking toward the monitor.* "It's seven-thirty on a Saturday and not a single person in this house is screaming, crying, or demanding a themed breakfast. I don't know whether to be relaxed or deeply suspicious."

Jake: *He smiles lazily, staring up at the ceiling and softly rubbing her shoulder.* "It's the suburban magic, Ames. The grass is absorbing all the chaos. Back in Brooklyn, by seven-thirty we'd already have heard three car alarms, a guy arguing with a pigeon, and Mac trying to build an indoor skate ramp out of sofa cushions."

Amy: *She turns her head slightly to look at him, her tone softening.* "He slept through the whole night again. Ever since we finished setting up the blackout curtains and the weighted blanket in his room, his sleep schedule has been incredible."

Jake: *He nodss his gaze softening as he thinks of his youngest.* "Yeah. His room really is the ultimate fortress of solitary chill. I went in to check on him around two a.m. and he was completely starfished under that blanket, sound asleep, looking like a little sensory-deprived king."

Narrator: *The house remains still, the monitor emitting only the barely audible hum of white noise from Jamie's bedroom, where the six-year-old is still resting peacefully in his custom setup.*

Captain: *He gives a single, curt nod, accepting your terms. To him, this is procedure. A traumatized witness is still a witness.* "Your request is noted, my lord. The Jarl will be informed of the situation and your insistence." *He steps back, clearing a path and gesturing sharply to the two guards assigned to you.* "Get him moving. Straight to the healers. No detours." 

Narrator: *The two guards flank you, their grips firm but not rough as they help you out of the cell. They feel the weight you put on them, the tremble you affect in your limbs, and their expressions are a mixture of caution and pity. The air in the corridor is thick with the smell of ozone and something else... something unnervingly like burnt meat. As they guide you past the dark stain on the floor, your shudder is perfectly timed, your revulsion palpable. The Captain watches your reaction with a hawk's intensity, filing it away.*

Captain: *His gaze then drops to the small pile of ash, his brow furrowed in deep, frustrated concentration.*

Narrator: *The other guards in the corridor part to let you pass, their faces pale and their eyes wide. You can hear their hushed, bewildered whispers as you are led toward the stone steps leading up and out of the dungeon's oppressive gloom. The heavy wooden door at the top is pulled open, and the comparatively warm, open air of the Dragonsreach main hall feels like a different world.*

Captain: *He calls out from behind you just as you reach the stairs, his voice a low growl that carries easily down the corridor.* "And when you are done with the healers, Lord Frey... you and I will have a long talk." *He doesn't wait for a response, already crouching down, his gauntleted hand hovering just over the grey dust of what was once Thorgar.* "What in the name of the gods uses magic like this?" *he mutters to himself, the question swallowed by the cold stone of the dungeon.*
*I turn to the girl.* "What's your name?" *I pull my badge out immediately, the chain dangling around my neck so she knows I'm not a threat.* "I'm a detective. You're ok."
*I hear Dad's comment and as he picks his coffee mug up I discreetly point my want at it, whispering.* "Evanesco..."

Narrator: *Jamie gives his wand a light flick upward, sending a silent wave of magical energy across the bullpen. Every set of blinds snaps open in unison, flooding the room once again with afternoon daylight.*

Amy: *diligently closes her notebook and caps her pen with an authoritative click.* "I am filing this under 'Approved Spatial and Physical Transformations' in the Liaison Archive. Though I will note in the margins that we need a strict contingency plan if a transfigured officer ever attempts to lay an egg on city property."

Terry: *lets out a long, heavy exhale and wipes his forehead.* "Terry is just glad Terry doesn't have to explain to the commissioner why one of our senior detectives had to be carried around in a coop. Good work, Potter. But next week — no farm animals."

Jake: *slaps Jamie on the back, leaning on the desk with a massive grin.* "Are you kidding? Next week we go bigger! I am talking giant mystical glowing swords, or maybe turning my desk chair into a hovercraft! Think of the high-speed chase potential!"

Jamie: *slips his English Oak wand smoothly back into his inner jacket sleeve with a smirk.* "One major transfiguration per quarter, Peralta. Ministry safety rules. But I am sure we can find something equally entertaining for next Friday's session."

Captain Holt: *adjusts his cuffs, stepping back toward his office door.* "A most informative afternoon, Detective Potter. The integration of Ministry magic and NYPD procedure continues to show remarkable promise. Now, everyone back to work. These felony assault files will not process themselves."

Narrator: *The squad slowly disperses back toward their respective desks as the regular Friday rhythm of the 99th precinct resumes, with Charles still happily whispering to Jake about the marvels of bird vision.*

Narrator: *The sharp trill of Amy's phone cuts through the cinematic explosions rattling the living room. She glances at the screen, her brow furrowing slightly at the unfamiliar out-of-state number, before she swipes to answer and taps the speaker button so she doesn't have to untangle herself from the blanket.*

Nurse Park: "Hello, is this Amy Peralta? Hi, my name is Nurse Park from Northwestern Memorial Hospital. I'm calling about an incident involving one Alice, Mark and Jamie Adams."

Narrator: *The casual, comfortable warmth vanishes from the room in a fraction of a second.*

Amy: *sits bolt upright and grips the edge of the coffee table.* "Yes, this is Amy Peralta. I'm Alice's sister. What incident? Are they okay?"

Jake: *grabs the television remote and slams the mute button.* "Are they at the hospital right now?"

Jake: *leans in close to his wife, his posture entirely changed. The relaxed dad critiquing action movies is gone, instantly replaced by a seasoned detective. He rests a heavy, grounding hand on Amy's shoulder, his eyes locked on the phone sitting illuminated on the glass table.*

Mac: *drops his handful of popcorn back into the bowl.* "Wait, what happened to Jamie?"

Amy: *waves a hand sharply to keep the kids quiet, her voice tight and professional despite the sudden tremor underneath.* "Nurse Park, please. Are my sister and her family alright? What is their status?"
*End of Chapter III.*
*As the park comes into view I squeal and let go of their hands, my tiny sneakers pounding the pavement as I run ahead. There's no roads to cross, so it's safe.* "Park! Weeee! Swing!"

Narrator: *The whirring hum of the central console stutters, casting a brief wash of amber light across Jamie's pale face. He watches the strange woman bound down the grated metal stairs toward him, completely unable to process the sheer velocity of her existence, let alone the words tumbling out of her mouth.*

Jamie: *holds up both hands defensively, taking a half-step back until his shoulder hits the wooden doors again.* "Whoa, whoa, alright, hold on a second. You can't just throw plasma-wasps and time machines at me in the exact same breath. I was ten in 2008, I don't know anything about radioactive meat pies!"

Narrator: *He stares at her hand, buried deep in her coat pocket, his flight-or-fight response completely short-circuiting. The air smells like ozone and dusty paper. It feels too real to be a hallucination, but too impossible to be life.*

Jamie: *rubs his temples fiercely, squeezing his eyes shut for a second before opening them again.* "Bigger on the inside. Right. Okay. It's a wooden box in an alleyway, but it's a cathedral in here. Physics is just taking a gap year, is it? And you're a doctor? Doctor of what, exactly? Engineering? Psychiatry? Because I think I might need the second one right now."

Narrator: *He drops his hands, looking past her toward the glowing mechanical heart of the ship, his voice finally losing its defensive edge, replaced by a very quiet, very genuine panic.*

Jamie: *swallows hard, his gaze snapping back to her face.* "Save Islington from what? That purple light outside? It was vaporising the concrete. The actual floor was just gone. Look, mate, I don't know who you are, but I just want to go home to my flat. Which might not even be there anymore, if whatever that is keeps expanding. How do you stop something that eats reality?"
*Without looking up from my paperwork I place a grate over the top of the candle, calmly.*
